title: Any Time, Any Space: A World-State-Centric Framework for Agentic Video Generation
summary: Long-form agentic video generation must turn a screenplay into shots that remain spatially and temporally consistent across nonconsecutive requests. Passing prompts or recent frames between shots does not provide a shared spatial frame for revisiting a scene or a time-indexed record for replaying an earlier event. We present Any Time, Any Space (ATAS), which compiles a screenplay into shot requests with explicit location, camera, and event-time references. Before generation, it retrieves relevant evidence from a scene memory of registered static geometry and an event memory of dynamic observations indexed by scene, event, and time. After generation, ATAS reconstructs and registers the clip. It updates memory only when review and state checks accept the observation, while film delivery remains independent of memory admission. Across four video generators, ATAS improves all reported cross-shot consistency measures and achieves the highest aggregate benchmark score for each backbone. It also outperforms the compared agents and 3D-guided methods on target-image spatial revisit, leads three event-recapture criteria, and receives the highest human ratings on all six criteria. The video results and code are available on our project page: https://lhmd.top/atas/.
translation:
标题：任意时间、任意空间：一种以世界状态为中心的智能体视频生成框架

摘要：长时程智能体视频生成必须将剧本转化为镜头，且这些镜头需在非连续请求之间保持空间与时间上的一致性。在镜头之间传递提示词或最近帧，既无法为重新访问某一场景提供共享空间框架，也无法为回放先前事件提供带时间索引的记录。我们提出任意时间、任意空间（ATAS），它将剧本编译为具有明确位置、摄像机和事件时间引用的镜头请求。在生成之前，它从由已配准静态几何构成的场景记忆，以及由按场景、事件和时间索引的动态观测构成的事件记忆中，检索相关证据。生成之后，ATAS 重建并登记该视频片段。仅当审查与状态检查接受该观测时，它才更新记忆，而成片交付仍独立于记忆准入。在四种视频生成器上，ATAS 改进了所有已报告的跨镜头一致性指标，并在每个骨干模型上取得最高综合基准分数。在目标图像空间重访上，它还优于所比较的智能体与3D引导方法，在三项事件重捕获准则上领先，并在全部六项准则上获得最高的人工评分。视频结果与代码可在我们的项目页面获取：https://lhmd.top/atas/。

title: Beyond Domain-Routed Supervision: Cross-Teacher Guarding for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) extends on-policy distillation (OPD) by routing domain-specific data to specialized teachers, integrating their capabilities through dense token-level supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, domain routing only distinguishes the supervision sources for different domains; updates from all domains still act on shared parameters. When teachers differ substantially in response style and domain expertise, supervision that is effective in isolation may still lead to persistent gradient conflicts and capability degradation during joint optimization. To address this challenge, we propose Cross-Teacher Guarding for MOPD (Road MOPD), which introduces non-routed teachers as auxiliary cross-domain critics on the same student trajectories and coordinates multi-teacher supervision through token-level credit assignment and gradient updates. Specifically, cross-teacher-guided credit assignment uses teacher agreement to strengthen token-level corrections jointly supported by the teachers and attenuate conflicting signals; preventive multi-teacher gradient projection uses auxiliary gradients from the same trajectories to constrain potentially conflicting updates and adaptively controls projection strength to retain target-domain learning signals. In experiments, Road MOPD mitigates degradation in the disadvantaged domain, gains over 5 percentage points under high conflict, and improves overall performance in low-conflict and three-domain settings.
translation:
标题：超越领域路由监督：面向多教师同策略蒸馏的跨教师守护

摘要：多教师同策略蒸馏（MOPD）通过将领域特定数据路由至专门教师，扩展了同策略蒸馏（OPD），并借助对学生生成轨迹的密集词元级监督来整合各教师能力。然而，领域路由仅区分了不同领域的监督来源；来自所有领域的更新仍作用于共享参数。当教师在响应风格和领域专长上差异显著时，单独有效的监督在联合优化中仍可能导致持续的梯度冲突和能力退化。为应对这一挑战，我们提出面向MOPD的跨教师守护（Road MOPD），其将非路由教师作为同一学生轨迹上的辅助跨域评判者，并通过词元级信用分配和梯度更新来协调多教师监督。具体而言，跨教师引导的信用分配利用教师间一致性来增强由教师共同支持的词元级修正，并削弱冲突信号；预防性多教师梯度投影利用来自同一轨迹的辅助梯度来约束潜在冲突更新，并自适应控制投影强度以保留目标领域学习信号。实验表明，Road MOPD缓解了劣势领域的退化，在高冲突下获得超过5个百分点的提升，并在低冲突及三领域设置中提升了整体性能。

title: Player-1: Learning to Play from Synthetic Experience
summary: Computer-use agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in interpreting screens and executing keyboard and mouse actions. However, games, with their visually rich worlds and diverse mechanics, remain challenging and offer a demanding next step toward general digital control. Current game-agent learning pipelines often rely on large-scale demonstrations with limited coverage of dynamic game states, while scalable environments for interactive training remain difficult to obtain. We introduce Player-1, a post-training framework for learning game control beyond demonstrations through synthetic experience. We extend the computer-use action space with relative pointer motion, sustained inputs, and composite actions. For supervised initialization, we fine-tune computer-use models on 6,044 curated gameplay trajectories that pair recorded actions with task instructions and visual reasoning. We construct Player-1-Gym, sixteen synthetic 2D and 3D environments designed around control demands shared across games. Programmatically verifiable rewards and randomized observations and control dynamics support multi-environment reinforcement learning with PPO. The resulting Player-1-9B and Player-1-35B-A3B improve MineDojo-300 success over their SFT policies by 27.8 and 17.7 percentage points, respectively. Player-1-9B reaches 38.33% success compared with 12.63% for the strongest evaluated baseline, with further gains over SFT on ViZDoom-10 and GameWorld. Further analyses show that broader synthetic environment coverage improves transfer, while the use of composite actions that combine multiple keyboard and mouse inputs increases during RL. We demonstrate that learning from synthetic experience substantially improves game control beyond supervised initialization, with gains that generalize beyond the RL training suite.
translation:
标题：Player-1：从合成经验中学习玩游戏

摘要：计算机使用智能体已展现出在解析屏幕和执行键盘与鼠标操作方面的强大能力。然而，游戏凭借其视觉丰富的世界和多样化的机制，仍然具有挑战性，并构成了迈向通用数字控制的高难度下一步。当前的游戏智能体学习流程通常依赖大规模演示数据，而这些数据对动态游戏状态的覆盖有限；同时，用于交互训练的可扩展环境仍然难以获得。我们提出 Player-1，一个通过合成经验学习超越演示数据的游戏控制的后训练框架。我们通过相对指针运动、持续输入和复合动作扩展了计算机使用动作空间。为了进行监督初始化，我们在 6,044 条精选游戏轨迹上微调计算机使用模型，这些轨迹将记录的动作与任务指令和视觉推理配对。我们构建了 Player-1-Gym，包含十六个合成的 2D 和 3D 环境，围绕跨游戏共享的控制需求设计。可通过程序验证的奖励以及随机化的观测和控制动态，支持使用 PPO 的多环境强化学习。所得的 Player-1-9B 和 Player-1-35B-A3B 在 MineDojo-300 上的成功率分别较其 SFT 策略提升了 27.8 和 17.7 个百分点。Player-1-9B 达到 38.33% 的成功率，而评估中最强的基线为 12.63%；在 ViZDoom-10 和 GameWorld 上相较 SFT 也有进一步提升。进一步分析表明，更广泛的合成环境覆盖可改善迁移，而在强化学习过程中，组合多个键盘和鼠标输入的复合动作的使用有所增加。我们证明，从合成经验中学习能够显著提升超越监督初始化的游戏控制能力，且这些增益可泛化到强化学习训练套件之外。

title: Doc2Harness: Benchmarking LLMs on Long-Horizon Harness Engineering of Coding Agents
summary: Agents driven by large language models are increasingly deployed on long-horizon tasks, where they use tools and modify real workspaces. How well they perform depends as much on the harness around the model as on the model itself. Existing benchmarks measure downstream task success under a fixed harness, leaving harness engineering itself unexplored. We propose Doc2Harness, a two-stage benchmark that evaluates long-horizon harness engineering directly. In Stage 1, a build model operating inside a fixed builder harness receives an interface-only contract skeleton and a development document that consolidates behavior across twelve frontier harnesses, and then constructs a complete candidate harness in an isolated container. In Stage 2, the frozen candidate harness runs in containers separate from the construction environment, one per test case, and is driven end to end by a scripted mock model. We score each test case using four observable channels, namely the requests sent to the model, the files on disk, the process exit code, and the command output; positive controls rule out vacuous passes. Across nineteen frontier models, each evaluated with three independent builds on 328 test cases, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest pass rate at 53.05%, while the weakest model reaches 27.44%, a gap of roughly twenty-six percentage points. Even the strongest model fails nearly half of the test cases, and failures cluster around how cross-cutting functionality is split across modules. To our knowledge, Doc2Harness provides the first deterministic benchmark for measuring long-horizon harness engineering.
translation:
标题：Doc2Harness：在编码代理的长时程框架工程上对大型语言模型进行基准测试

摘要：由大型语言模型驱动的代理越来越多地部署在长时程任务中，它们使用工具并修改真实工作空间。它们的表现如何，既取决于模型本身，也取决于模型周围的框架。现有基准测试在固定框架下衡量下游任务的成功，而框架工程本身尚未得到探索。我们提出 Doc2Harness，一个两阶段的基准测试，直接评估长时程框架工程。在第一阶段，一个在固定构建器框架内运行的构建模型接收一个仅包含接口的契约骨架和一份整合了十二个前沿框架行为的开发文档，然后在一个隔离容器中构建一个完整的候选框架。在第二阶段，冻结的候选框架在与构建环境分离的容器中运行，每个测试用例一个容器，并由一个脚本化的模拟模型端到端驱动。我们使用四个可观察通道对每个测试用例进行评分，即发送给模型的请求、磁盘上的文件、进程退出代码和命令输出；阳性对照排除了空洞通过。在十九个前沿模型中，每个模型在328个测试用例上进行三次独立构建评估，GPT-6 Astra 达到了最高的通过率53.05%，而最弱的模型达到27.44%，差距约为26个百分点。即使是最强的模型也未能通过近一半的测试用例，失败集中在横切功能如何跨模块拆分上。据我们所知，Doc2Harness 提供了首个用于衡量长时程框架工程的确定性基准测试。

title: Recovering Reliable Supervision via Critique-Guided On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on its own rollouts with token-level supervision from a teacher, assuming that the teacher can reach a correct answer from any prefix the student writes. We call this property the recoverability of the teacher and show it fails on incorrect rollouts: the teacher follows student errors, although it recognizes them. We propose CriticOPD, using error recognition to restore recoverability. The teacher critiques an incorrect rollout, allowing the student to rewrite its solution following the error. The resulting output, including the critique as privileged information, is scored by the teacher while the student uses the revision without the critique for training. On two Qwen3 students and six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, CriticOPD improves OPD, with the largest gains on competition problems.
translation:
标题：通过评析引导的同策略蒸馏恢复可靠监督

摘要：同策略蒸馏（OPD）在学生模型自身生成的轨迹上训练学生模型，并利用教师模型提供的词元级监督，其假设是教师模型能够从学生写出的任意前缀出发得到正确答案。我们将这一性质称为教师模型的可恢复性，并表明它在错误轨迹上并不成立：教师模型虽然能识别学生的错误，却会沿袭这些错误。我们提出 CriticOPD，利用错误识别来恢复教师模型的可恢复性。教师模型对错误的生成轨迹进行评析，使学生模型能够在出错后重写其解答。由此得到的输出（将评析作为特权信息包含在内）由教师模型评分，而学生模型在训练时使用不含评析的修订结果。在两个 Qwen3 学生模型和六个数学推理基准上，CriticOPD 提升了 OPD，且在竞赛题上增益最大。

title: LatentLoop: Scaling Looped MoE Models with Asymmetric Compute Allocation
summary: Looped Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models combine parameter reuse with sparse computation to improve performance under matched budgets. Prior work demonstrates that different loop visits can play different roles even when they share parameters. To probe the contributions of different loop visits, we learn separate residual coefficients in a model that applies a shared block twice, observing a smaller scale in the first visit. Fixed coefficient experiments show that reducing the first visit's scale preserves or improves performance, whereas the same reductions to the second hurt it. This asymmetry motivates us to explore asymmetric compute allocation. We propose LatentLoop, which compresses the first visit's sequence, retains full resolution in the second, and reallocates saved computation to increase the hidden size. We further learn how strongly the first visit updates the full sequence, and share MoE weights across visits while using separate attention parameters to accommodate their different sequence resolutions. Across 15 configurations spanning 1.3B--7B parameters, with the largest budget exceeding 10^{21} FLOPs, LatentLoop consistently lowers validation NLL. At a fitted NLL of 1.988, predicted compute savings are 19.0\% and 7.9\% relative to vanilla MoE and the looped baseline. It also improves average scores on nine benchmarks at all sizes in 0-shot and 5-shot settings. These results suggest asymmetric compute allocation is a promising direction for looped MoE models.
translation:
标题：LatentLoop：以非对称计算分配扩展循环式 MoE 模型

摘要：循环式混合专家（MoE）模型将参数复用与稀疏计算相结合，以在匹配预算下提升性能。已有工作表明，即使共享参数，不同的循环访问也可发挥不同作用。为探究不同循环访问的贡献，我们在一个将共享模块应用两次的模型中学习独立的残差系数，并观察到第一次访问的尺度较小。固定系数实验表明，降低第一次访问的尺度可保持或提升性能，而对第二次访问进行相同幅度的降低则会损害性能。这种不对称性促使我们探索非对称计算分配。我们提出 LatentLoop，它压缩第一次访问的序列，在第二次访问中保留全分辨率，并重新分配节省的计算量以增大隐藏维度。我们进一步学习第一次访问对完整序列的更新强度，并在不同访问间共享 MoE 权重，同时使用单独的注意力参数以适应其不同的序列分辨率。在涵盖 1.3B–7B 参数的 15 种配置中（最大预算超过 10^21 FLOPs），LatentLoop 持续降低验证 NLL。在拟合 NLL 为 1.988 时，相对于普通 MoE 和循环基线，预测计算节省分别为 19.0% 和 7.9%。它还在 0-shot 和 5-shot 设置下，在所有规模上提升了九个基准的平均分数。这些结果表明，非对称计算分配是循环式 MoE 模型的一个有前景的方向。

title: Cortex: Consolidating Context into Parametric Memory
summary: Context can improve large language model performance, but these gains may be lost after context removal. Inspired by biological systems consolidation, we formulate Memory Consolidation (MC) as internalizing these gains while preserving non-target capabilities, connecting context-specified editing, skill learning, and behavioral steering under a common objective. We introduce a five-task-family testbed measuring consolidation and retention under single, batch, and sequential updates. We propose Cortex, which generates prospective queries to anticipate uses of context and distills context-conditioned outputs into mergeable low-rank or structural feed-forward network updates. Across 4B--120B dense and mixture-of-experts backbones, including both text-only and multimodal models, Cortex lies on the empirical consolidation--retention Pareto frontier in most evaluated settings. After 50 sequential factual edits on a 14B model, Cortex-Structural recovers 88.9% of the context-induced gain while retaining 99.8% of original non-target performance.
translation:
标题：Cortex：将上下文巩固为参数化记忆

摘要：上下文能够提升大语言模型的性能，但这些增益在上下文移除后可能丧失。受生物系统巩固机制的启发，我们将记忆巩固（Memory Consolidation, MC）定义为在保留非目标能力的同时内化这些增益，并将上下文指定的编辑、技能学习和行为引导统一在一个共同目标下。我们提出了一个包含五个任务族的测试平台，用于衡量在单次、批量及顺序更新下的巩固与保持效果。我们提出了Cortex，它通过生成前瞻性查询来预判上下文的用途，并将上下文条件输出蒸馏为可合并的低秩或结构化前馈网络更新。在4B至120B的稠密模型和混合专家骨干网络上，包括纯文本和多模态模型，Cortex在大多数评估设置中均位于经验性的巩固—保持帕累托前沿。在对14B模型进行50次顺序事实编辑后，Cortex-Structural恢复了88.9%的上下文诱导增益，同时保持了99.8%的原始非目标性能。

title: ActionOPD: Distilling Decisions, Not Tokens
summary: Distilling capable language-model agents into smaller models requires aligning the student's behavior with the teacher's. This raises a fundamental question: at which states and at what granularity should this alignment be performed? Offline imitation provides dense but token-specific supervision and can suffer from state-distribution mismatch. Token-level on-policy distillation (OPD) addresses this mismatch but typically requires teacher token probabilities and compatible tokenization. We argue that semantic actions provide a natural unit of supervision for agent distillation. We introduce ActionOPD, an action-level on-policy distillation method motivated by maximizing expected teacher-action likelihood at student-encountered states. At each such state, ActionOPD samples actions from both the student and a black-box teacher, rewarding student actions according to their semantic agreement with the sampled teacher actions. Through policy optimization, ActionOPD aligns the student's action-level behavior with the teacher's decisions without requiring reproduction of teacher-written reasoning or access to teacher token probabilities. Training Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B with two teachers on diverse, curated tool-use tasks yields average gains of 3.3-6.9 percentage points across four out-of-distribution benchmarks. ActionOPD scales favorably with student size and teacher capability, without requiring the teacher and student to share a model family or tokenizer. On τ^2-bench, ActionOPD achieves competitive performance against offline distillation and token-level OPD. We further explore Self-ActionOPD with a same-model teacher and privileged context. These results establish ActionOPD as a promising approach to agent distillation.
translation:
标题：ActionOPD：蒸馏决策，而非词元

摘要：将能力强的语言模型智能体蒸馏到更小的模型中，需要使学生行为与教师行为对齐。这引出一个根本问题：应在哪些状态以及以何种粒度执行这种对齐？离线模仿提供密集但特定于词元的监督，并且可能遭遇状态分布不匹配。词元级在策略蒸馏（OPD）能够解决这一不匹配，但通常需要教师的词元概率以及兼容的分词方式。我们认为，语义动作是智能体蒸馏的一种自然监督单元。我们提出 ActionOPD，一种动作级在策略蒸馏方法，其目标是在学生遇到的状态上最大化期望的教师动作似然。在每个此类状态，ActionOPD 从学生和黑盒教师中采样动作，并根据学生动作与所采样教师动作之间的语义一致性对学生动作给予奖励。通过策略优化，ActionOPD 将学生的动作级行为与教师的决策对齐，而无需复现教师撰写的推理过程，也无需访问教师的词元概率。使用两个教师，在多样化的精选工具使用任务上训练 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B，在四个分布外基准上平均提升 3.3 至 6.9 个百分点。ActionOPD 随学生模型规模和教师能力提升而良好扩展，且不要求教师与学生共享同一模型家族或分词器。在 τ^2-bench 上，ActionOPD 相较于离线蒸馏和词元级 OPD 取得了有竞争力的性能。我们进一步探索了使用同模型教师和特权上下文的 Self-ActionOPD。这些结果确立了 ActionOPD 作为智能体蒸馏的一种有前景方法。

title: More Methods, Better Agents? A Reality Check on Self-Distillation in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Self-distillation in agentic reinforcement learning has produced a growing number of methods. However, existing evaluations often reuse published baseline scores under differing experimental conditions, provide few direct comparisons among contemporaneous methods, and give limited attention to training stability and computational cost. These limitations obscure the source of reported gains and the practical strengths and weaknesses of competing methods. Costly agent training further motivates a common basis for comparison. To address these gaps, we compare ten representative methods against GRPO on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, Search-QA, and WebShop across three model sizes. Our study comprises 132 training runs totaling 12,124.4 recorded H800 GPU-hours, with repeated evaluations over eight rollout seeds for the pretrained backbones and all eleven trained methods. Beyond final task performance, we examine training progress, stability, and measured computational cost. Our evaluation yields three key findings. First, gains over GRPO remain limited in scope, with no method consistently outperforming it across settings. Second, strong final performance can mask unstable training. Third, additional training cost does not consistently translate into better performance. We establish this benchmark to support fair, comprehensive comparison and guide future research toward reliable and cost-effective improvements in agent training. Project page: https://aim-uofa.github.io/Self-Distillation-AgentRL/
translation:
标题：更多方法，更好的智能体？智能体强化学习中自蒸馏的现实检验

摘要：智能体强化学习中的自蒸馏方法日益增多。然而，现有评估往往在不同实验条件下复用已发表的基线分数，鲜有对同期方法进行直接比较，且对训练稳定性和计算成本的关注有限。这些局限掩盖了所报告增益的来源以及竞争方法的实际优缺点。高昂的智能体训练成本进一步凸显了建立共同比较基础的必要性。为弥补这些不足，我们在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、Search-QA和WebShop四个基准上，针对三种模型规模，比较了十种代表性方法与GRPO。本研究共包含132次训练运行，累计记录12,124.4个H800 GPU小时，并对预训练骨干网络及全部十一种训练方法在八个rollout种子下进行了重复评估。除最终任务性能外，我们还考察了训练进展、稳定性和实测计算成本。我们的评估得出三项关键发现。第一，相较于GRPO的增益范围仍然有限，没有任何方法在所有设置下持续优于GRPO。第二，优异的最终性能可能掩盖训练的不稳定性。第三，额外的训练成本并不总能转化为更好的性能。我们建立此基准以支持公平、全面的比较，并引导未来研究朝向可靠且经济高效的智能体训练改进方向发展。项目页面：https://aim-uofa.github.io/Self-Distillation-AgentRL/

title: Seeing, Maintaining, and Learning: The Evolution of Multimodal Agent Memory
summary: Multimodal models and agents have emerged to enable AI systems to learn from and interact with the real world more like humans by integrating information across multiple modalities. However, enabling multimodal agents to continually acquire useful information from complex, heterogeneous multimodal data remains a significant challenge as they move toward long-horizon tasks and lifelong settings. Addressing this challenge requires effective memory mechanisms that can maintain continuity across sessions, adapt to changing users and environments, and refine memory-management policies through accumulated experience. We introduce a two-axis analytical framework for multimodal agent memory structured around two key questions: how multimodal information is formed and represented (Axis I, Formation and Representation), and how its management adapts with accumulated experience (Axis II, Memory Management). Axis I, Formation and Representation, characterizes what information is retained and how it is encoded (e.g., modality-specific embeddings, textual and structured records, latent and parametric representations) to support subsequent reasoning and action. Axis II, Memory Management, distinguishes three tiers: T1 Static Memory reuses fixed memory; T2 Dynamic Memory updates memory through a stable policy; and T3 Self-Evolving Memory updates memory through an evolving policy. Based on this framework, we synthesize recurring design patterns and derive principles for balancing source fidelity with abstraction, maintaining temporal validity and provenance, grounding memory use in recoverable evidence, and evolving memory policies over time. Furthermore, we discuss the challenges and potential future directions for the memory mechanism of multimodal agents.
translation:
标题：看见、维护与学习：多模态智能体记忆的演化

摘要：多模态模型与智能体已经出现，它们通过整合跨多个模态的信息，使 AI 系统能够更像人类一样从现实世界学习并与之交互。然而，随着多模态智能体迈向长时程任务和终身场景，使其能够从复杂、异构的多模态数据中持续获取有用信息仍是一项重大挑战。应对这一挑战需要有效的记忆机制，其能够跨会话保持连续性、适应不断变化的用户与环境，并通过积累的经验改进记忆管理策略。我们提出了一个面向多模态智能体记忆的双轴分析框架，围绕两个关键问题构建：多模态信息如何形成与表示（轴 I：形成与表示），以及其管理如何随积累的经验而适应（轴 II：记忆管理）。轴 I（形成与表示）刻画了哪些信息被保留以及如何对其进行编码（例如，模态特定的嵌入、文本和结构化记录、潜在表示与参数化表示），以支持后续推理与行动。轴 II（记忆管理）区分了三个层级：T1 静态记忆复用固定记忆；T2 动态记忆通过稳定策略更新记忆；T3 自演化记忆通过不断演化的策略更新记忆。在该框架基础上，我们综合归纳了反复出现的设计模式，并推导出以下原则：平衡源保真度与抽象性、保持时间有效性与来源可追溯性、将记忆使用建立在可恢复证据之上，以及使记忆策略随时间演化。此外，我们讨论了多模态智能体记忆机制面临的挑战及潜在未来方向。

title: LensErase: A Foundation Model for Erase Anything
summary: We introduce LensErase, a general-purpose mask-based Erase Anything foundation model designed to cover a broad spectrum of real-world erase scenarios. LensErase supports diverse objects, visual text, watermarks, associated visual effects, multiple-object removal, and a wide range of object scales, aspect ratios, and image resolutions. First, to enable such broad coverage, we construct LensErase-100M, a large-scale dataset containing 101.07 million paired source-mask-target examples spanning diverse erase scenarios. Second, we pretrain LensErase from the text-to-image model Lens, adapting its strong generative prior to mask-based erasing. To efficiently incorporate the source image and erase mask, we propose Mask-Aware RoPE, a 3D rotary positional encoding that directly injects mask information into the source-image tokens without introducing a separate mask token sequence. Finally, we refine the model through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with contract-guided, region-aware rewards, and apply TraceFusion at inference to preserve high-fidelity content outside the effective edit region. Across six public benchmarks and the proposed LensErase-Bench, LensErase achieves substantial improvements under both reference-based objective metrics and reference-free VLM evaluation. We hope LensErase can serve as a foundational model for erase-related applications and systems.
translation:
标题：[LensErase：用于擦除任意内容的基础模型]
摘要：我们提出了 LensErase，一种通用的基于掩码的“擦除任意内容”基础模型，旨在覆盖广泛的真实世界擦除场景。LensErase 支持多种对象、视觉文本、水印、相关视觉效果、多对象擦除，以及广泛的对象尺度、宽高比和图像分辨率。首先，为实现如此广泛的覆盖，我们构建了 LensErase-100M，一个包含 1.0107 亿个成对的源图像-掩码-目标样本、涵盖多样擦除场景的大规模数据集。其次，我们基于文本到图像模型 Lens 预训练 LensErase，将其强大的生成先验适配到基于掩码的擦除任务中。为了高效融合源图像和擦除掩码，我们提出了 Mask-Aware RoPE，一种三维旋转位置编码，可将掩码信息直接注入源图像 token，而无需引入单独的掩码 token 序列。最后，我们通过监督微调和采用契约引导、区域感知奖励的强化学习对模型进行优化，并在推理时应用 TraceFusion，以保留有效编辑区域之外的高保真内容。在六个公开基准测试和所提出的 LensErase-Bench 上，LensErase 在基于参考的客观指标和无参考的 VLM 评估下均取得了显著提升。我们希望 LensErase 能成为擦除相关应用与系统的基础模型。

title: KV4-RL: Unlocking Faster Asynchronous Rollouts for RLVR with INT4 KV Cache Quantization
summary: Asynchronous rollout improves the efficiency of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) by reducing under-utilization during long-tail generation. Sustained concurrency also concentrates context processing into fewer decode steps, increasing the KV workload per step. We characterize this KV concentration and find that KV cache quantization delivers substantially greater acceleration than weight-only and weight-activation quantization in our matched-workload comparisons. However, INT4 KV rollout can degrade learning even with token-level truncated importance sampling (TIS). We propose KV4-RL, which combines calibration-free INT4 KV quantization with selective INT8 protection of attention sinks and recent context. Protecting a bounded number of positions reduces sampler mismatch while retaining most of the speedup from INT4. Across 400 iterations of Qwen3-8B-Base GRPO training, KV4-RL achieves 1.80times cumulative rollout speedup and 1.27times cumulative full-iteration speedup over BF16 rollout, reaching 1.97times rollout speedup over the final 50 iterations. Under a common BF16 evaluator, its final six-benchmark mean accuracy is within 0.5 percentage points of BF16-rollout training for both Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base.
translation:
标题：KV4-RL：通过INT4 KV缓存量化解锁更快的RLVR异步展开

摘要：异步展开通过减少长尾生成期间的利用率不足，提升了带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）的效率。持续并发还会将上下文处理集中到更少的解码步骤中，从而增加每步的KV负载。我们刻画了这种KV集中现象，并在匹配工作负载比较中发现，KV缓存量化比仅权重量化和权重-激活量化带来显著更大的加速。然而，即便采用token级截断重要性采样（TIS），INT4 KV展开也可能导致学习性能退化。我们提出KV4-RL，它将免校准的INT4 KV量化与对注意力汇点（attention sinks）和近期上下文的选择性INT8保护相结合。保护有界数量的位置可减少采样器不匹配，同时保留INT4的大部分加速。在Qwen3-8B-Base GRPO训练的400次迭代中，KV4-RL相较BF16展开实现了1.80倍累积展开加速和1.27倍累积全迭代加速，并在最后50次迭代中达到1.97倍展开加速。在统一的BF16评估器下，对于Qwen3-4B-Base和Qwen3-8B-Base，其最终六个基准的平均准确率均与BF16展开训练相差不超过0.5个百分点。

title: Towards Agentic Robots: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness
summary: Foundation models are driving a paradigm shift in robotic intelligence, moving beyond low-level action prediction to goal-directed orchestration of data collection, model training, task planning, and real-world execution. We characterize this emerging paradigm as an agentic robots, in which agents reason over human instructions, interact with robotic environments, rectify execution errors autonomously, and dynamically adjust operational strategies. Although this field develops fast, current studies are not well connected. Researchers have no consistent view of how to combine different agentic functions into a complete robot system. This paper provides a unified overview of existing research on agentic robots. We first trace the development from robot policies to agentic systems, covering vision-language-action models, world models, and world-action models. We then clarify the definition and scope of agentic robots and organize existing research into seventeen categories across four functional domains: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness. Across these domains, we examine how agents shape model learning and robot decisions, collect and curate robot data, construct worlds, tasks, and tests for learning and evaluation, and organize capabilities for robot use. Finally, we discuss open challenges and outline directions for future research. Looking forward, we hope this work contributes to a clearer understanding of agentic robots and supports new approaches to making them more capable, reliable, and adaptive.
translation:
标题：迈向智能体化机器人：模型、数据、环境与运行框架

摘要：基础模型正在推动机器人智能的范式转变，使其超越低级动作预测，转向对数据收集、模型训练、任务规划和真实世界执行的目标导向编排。我们将这一新兴范式称为智能体化机器人：其中智能体能够对人类指令进行推理、与机器人环境交互、自主纠正执行错误，并动态调整操作策略。尽管该领域发展迅速，但当前研究之间缺乏良好衔接，研究者对于如何将不同的智能体功能整合为一个完整的机器人系统尚未形成一致观点。本文对现有智能体化机器人研究进行了统一综述。我们首先梳理从机器人策略到智能体系统的发展脉络，涵盖视觉-语言-动作模型、世界模型和世界-动作模型。随后，我们明确智能体化机器人的定义与范围，并将现有研究按四个功能领域——模型、数据、环境和运行框架（Harness）——组织为十七个类别。在这些领域中，我们考察智能体如何塑造模型学习与机器人决策、收集与整理机器人数据、为学习与评估构建世界、任务和测试，以及组织供机器人使用的能力。最后，我们讨论开放性挑战并勾勒未来研究方向。展望未来，我们希望这项工作有助于更清晰地理解智能体化机器人，并为使其能力更强、更可靠、更具适应性提供新思路。

title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents
summary: How can we build an agent that thinks beyond human language, yet still acts through it in the external environment? Modern LLM agents still reason and interact through text, while latent reasoning offers an efficient internal medium but lacks native tool access and reasoning transparency. We bridge these two directions with Hybrid Reasoning Agents (HybridAgents), which dynamically navigate between latent reasoning and text-based interaction throughout a unified generation process. Architecturally, a lightweight HybridLink enables seamless transitions between text and latent modes, while the agent's continuous working memory preserves lossless hybrid context across multiple turns. These designs preserve tool-integrated agentic capabilities while making latent thoughts directly inspectable. Building on this architecture, we further develop dedicated post-training algorithms for hybrid reasoning: HybridSFT stabilizes tool-integrated hybrid generation by teaching the backbone to coordinate with HybridLink, then HybridRL scales reasoning by learning when to think in latent space and when to act through text. We evaluate HybridAgent at 3 model scales across 11 benchmarks covering mathematics, science, medicine, search, and agentic reasoning. Compared with frontier LLM Agents and agentic frameworks spanning both text-based and latent methods, HybridAgent consistently improves performance by 10.4%, while delivering 35.5%-54.7% token reduction, 1.8x-2.6x faster inference, and 2.7x-3.7x cost savings. Code and data are available at https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent.
translation:
标题：混合推理智能体

摘要：我们如何构建一个能够超越人类语言进行思考、却仍通过人类语言在外部环境中行动的智能体？现代 LLM 智能体仍通过文本进行推理和交互，而潜在推理提供了一种高效的内部媒介，但缺乏原生工具访问能力和推理透明度。我们通过混合推理智能体（HybridAgents）连接这两个方向，它在统一生成过程中动态地在潜在推理与基于文本的交互之间切换。在架构上，轻量级 HybridLink 支持文本模式与潜在模式之间的无缝转换，而智能体的连续工作记忆在多个轮次中保持无损的混合上下文。这些设计在保留工具集成智能体能力的同时，使潜在思维可直接检查。基于此架构，我们进一步开发了用于混合推理的专用后训练算法：HybridSFT 通过教导主干模型与 HybridLink 协同，稳定工具集成的混合生成；随后 HybridRL 通过学习何时在潜在空间中思考、何时通过文本行动，来扩展推理能力。我们在 3 种模型规模上，针对涵盖数学、科学、医学、搜索和智能体推理的 11 个基准测试评估了 HybridAgent。与前沿 LLM 智能体以及涵盖基于文本和潜在方法的智能体框架相比，HybridAgent 性能持续提升 10.4%，同时实现 35.5%-54.7% 的 token 减少、1.8 倍至 2.6 倍的推理加速，以及 2.7 倍至 3.7 倍的成本节省。代码和数据见 https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent。

title: HumanoidToolBench: Benchmarking Humanoid Tool Use from Selection to Mobile Execution
summary: As robotic hardware and learning methods advance, humanoids need tools to perform tasks beyond their inherent physical limits. Successful tool use requires selecting a suitable tool and coordinating manipulation and, when needed, locomotion to complete the task. Existing benchmarks do not jointly evaluate these capabilities on a humanoid. We introduce HumanoidToolBench, an 18-task benchmark spanning three scenarios, three execution levels, and two tool-set modes, together with ToolBook, a dataset of 3.1k demonstrations collected in simulation and on a real Unitree G1. Evaluation of seven policies in simulation and three on the real robot reveals substantial gaps between selecting a suitable tool and completing the task. Focused GR00T N1.7 probes show reduced selection accuracy on unseen tools and continued task execution under unrelated instructions. Code and data are available at https://snu-pi.github.io/HumanoidToolBench/.
translation:
标题：HumanoidToolBench：从工具选择到移动执行的类人工具使用基准测试

摘要：随着机器人硬件和学习方法的进步，类人机器人需要借助工具来完成超出其自身物理极限的任务。成功的工具使用需要选择合适的工具，并协调操作以及（在需要时）移动以完成任务。现有基准测试并未在类人机器人上联合评估这些能力。我们提出了HumanoidToolBench，一个包含18项任务的基准测试，涵盖三种场景、三个执行层级和两种工具集模式，并配套构建了ToolBook——一个包含3.1k条示范的数据集，这些示范在仿真环境和真实Unitree G1机器人上采集。对仿真环境中七种策略以及真实机器人上三种策略的评估表明，在选择合适工具与完成任务之间仍存在显著差距。针对GR00T N1.7的专项探测显示，其在未见工具上的选择准确率下降，并且在不相关指令下仍继续执行任务。代码和数据见 https://snu-pi.github.io/HumanoidToolBench/。

title: Super-Resolution in The Right Latent Space: A Frozen Vision-Foundation Substrate
summary: In an image latent space, the embeddings of high-resolution, natural, and sharp images form a manifold. Degradation of high-resolution images pushes their embeddings off this manifold. Real-world super-resolution (SR) then becomes the task of mapping the degraded embedding back onto this manifold --- not anywhere on the manifold, but to the point that preserves what the input still carries, both its semantics and pixel details. Every published method implements this mapping in a reconstruction-oriented latent space or pixel space. We claim these spaces are the wrong substrates for SR. Low-resolution and degraded images are embedded far from the manifold, making the mapping difficult and expensive. The lack of semantic information in these substrates also makes it difficult to navigate to the faithful point on the manifold, causing severe hallucination when degradation is heavy. Thus, restoring in a suitable latent space is crucial to the SR task. We show that the latent space of 23 fused layers of a frozen DINOv3-L is one such space that makes the SR task easier. Degraded images are embedded near the manifold. Moreover, this substrate contains a hierarchy of information, from pixel record to degradation robust semantics, guiding the model to find the faithful point on the manifold. On this substrate, a 415M decoder is trained under reconstruction and adversarial objectives to map the degraded embeddings back and decode to pixel space in one pass. The resulting model, RAESR, attains the best fidelity--perception trade-off among state-of-the-art adversarial and diffusion-based restorers on RealSR, DRealSR, LSDIR and DIV2K-Val, at 37 ms per 512 by 512 image on a single H20 GPU. Swapping the substrate for a VAE latent under an identical recipe loses on every metric.
translation:
标题：在正确的潜在空间中进行超分辨率：一种冻结的视觉基础基底

摘要：在图像潜在空间中，高分辨率、自然且清晰的图像的嵌入构成一个流形。高分辨率图像的退化会将其嵌入推离该流形。现实世界超分辨率（SR）因而成为将退化嵌入映射回该流形的任务——不是映射到流形上的任意位置，而是映射到能够保留输入仍然携带的信息（包括其语义和像素细节）的点。每个已发表的方法都在面向重建的潜在空间或像素空间中实现这种映射。我们主张，这些空间对于 SR 而言是错误的基底。低分辨率和退化图像被嵌入在远离流形的位置，使映射困难且代价高昂。这些基底缺乏语义信息，也使得难以定位到流形上的忠实点，从而在退化严重时导致严重幻觉。因此，在合适的潜在空间中进行恢复对 SR 任务至关重要。我们表明，冻结的 DINOv3-L 的 23 个融合层的潜在空间正是这样一个使 SR 任务更容易的空间。退化图像被嵌入在流形附近。此外，该基底包含从像素记录到对退化鲁棒的语义的信息层级，引导模型找到流形上的忠实点。在该基底上，一个 415M 解码器在重建目标和对抗目标下训练，以将退化嵌入映射回去并单次解码到像素空间。所得模型 RAESR 在 RealSR、DRealSR、LSDIR 和 DIV2K-Val 上，在最新的对抗式和扩散式恢复器中取得了最佳的保真度—感知权衡，在单块 H20 GPU 上每张 512×512 图像耗时 37 ms。在相同训练方案下将基底替换为 VAE 潜在空间，则在所有指标上均落败。

title: APT: Feedback-Driven Agentic Post-Training for Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Post-training is crucial for improving text-to-image models, yet existing pipelines typically rely on manually curated training data and fixed training distributions. We introduce APT (Agentic Post-Training), a fully automated framework that adaptively post-trains a base model according to its evolving capability profile. APT coordinates three agents to construct evaluation sets from user requirements, diagnose model-specific strengths and failure modes, and generate reinforcement learning data with an adaptive prompt distribution that emphasizes underperforming capabilities. By repeatedly evaluating, diagnosing, and updating the generator, APT lets the current model's behavior shape its next training tasks, forming a feedback loop inspired by recursive self-improvement. For general-purpose settings without user-specified evaluation scenarios, we further develop an evaluation harness that enables broad and diverse evaluation set generation. Experiments across multiple base models, benchmarks, and generation architectures demonstrate that APT is model-agnostic, benchmark-agnostic, architecture-agnostic, and fully automated.
translation:
标题：APT：面向文本到图像生成的反馈驱动智能体后训练

摘要：后训练对于改进文本到图像模型至关重要，然而现有流程通常依赖于人工整理好的训练数据和固定的训练分布。我们提出了APT（智能体后训练），一个全自动框架，能够根据基础模型不断演进的能力画像对其进行自适应后训练。APT协调三个智能体，从用户需求出发构建评估集，诊断模型特定的优势与失败模式，并生成具有自适应提示分布的强化学习数据，该分布侧重于表现不足的能力。通过反复评估、诊断和更新生成器，APT让当前模型的行为塑造其下一轮训练任务，形成一个受递归自我改进启发的反馈循环。对于没有用户指定评估场景的通用设置，我们进一步开发了一套评估工具，能够实现广泛且多样化的评估集生成。在多个基础模型、基准测试和生成架构上的实验表明，APT具有模型无关性、基准无关性、架构无关性，并且完全自动化。

title: The Thinking Leakage in Reinforcement Learning for LLMs
summary: Hybrid reasoning models such as the Qwen3 series switch between a THINK mode and a NO-THINK mode through a few chat-template tokens. A popular recipe trains such models with reinforcement learning in NO-THINK mode and reports improved reasoning performance. We provide evidence that much of this gain can be explained by thinking leakage: the gain comes largely from partially reactivating the reasoning abilities of the original model's THINK mode instead of learning enhanced reasoning behavior. We train Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B with GRPO in NO-THINK mode. As accuracy improves, responses become longer and more reflective, are increasingly judged by the original model to resemble its own thinking, and the model's internal activations shift toward its THINK mode. We then investigate at the level of weights, activations, and attention heads: scaling the RL update further elicits THINK-mode behavior and approaches THINK-mode accuracy but does not exceed it; in Qwen3-8B, replacing a low-dimensional THINK-related activation subspace of the RL-trained model with its original-model value removes most of the RL gain, and the reverse exchange transfers a considerable fraction of the gain to the original model; and the RL-induced shift passes through the attention heads that read the empty think block. We further identify a possible mechanism in the GRPO training signal: responses favored by the advantage-weighted update are more THINK-like, and a gradient step computed from this signal moves the model toward its THINK state. Thus, gains in NO-THINK mode can largely reflect reactivation of reasoning abilities already present in the original model.
translation:
标题：大语言模型强化学习中的思维泄漏

摘要：诸如Qwen3系列之类的混合推理模型，通过少量聊天模板token在THINK模式与NO-THINK模式之间切换。一种流行的方法是在NO-THINK模式下通过强化学习训练此类模型，并报告其推理性能有所提升。我们提供证据表明，这种提升在很大程度上可以由思维泄漏来解释：性能增益主要来自部分重新激活原始模型THINK模式的推理能力，而非学习到增强的推理行为。我们在NO-THINK模式下使用GRPO训练Qwen3-1.7B、4B和8B。随着准确率提升，回答变得更长、更具反思性，被原始模型判定为越来越像其自身的思考，并且模型的内部激活逐渐向THINK模式偏移。随后，我们从权重、激活和注意力头层面进行研究：进一步扩大强化学习更新会诱发THINK模式行为，并接近THINK模式的准确率，但不会超过它；在Qwen3-8B中，将经强化学习训练的模型中一个低维的、与THINK相关的激活子空间替换为原始模型的值，会消除大部分强化学习带来的增益，而反向替换则会将相当一部分增益转移到原始模型；并且，这种由强化学习引起的偏移会经过那些读取空think块的注意力头。我们进一步识别出GRPO训练信号中一种可能的机制：被优势加权更新偏好的回答更像THINK模式，而根据该信号计算出的梯度步骤会将模型推向其THINK状态。因此，NO-THINK模式下的增益在很大程度上反映的是对原始模型中已有推理能力的重新激活。

title: RuleTrek: Benchmarking Agentic Rule Reasoning in Complex Scenarios
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly tackle complex real-world tasks in specialized domains. However, identifying and correctly applying domain-specific rules remains challenging when scenario information is distributed across multiple files. Existing rule-reasoning benchmarks typically represent scenarios using only a few factual statements, simplifying the identification and application of relevant rules. To address this gap, this paper introduces RuleTrek, a multi-domain benchmark for agentic rule reasoning in complex scenarios. Its rule-grounded construction pipeline extracts structured rule graphs, generates and incrementally composes rule-specific sub-scenarios while ensuring consistency and solvability. To systematically evaluate agentic rule reasoning in complex scenarios, RuleTrek assesses three capabilities in interactive workspaces: Rule Identification (RI), Rule Deduction (RD), and End-to-End Rule Reasoning (E2E). Experiments on 11 frontier LLMs show that the highest RI and RD scores are only 62.47\% and 60.43\%, respectively, while E2E scores range from 26.97\% to 55.29\%. These results demonstrate that current LLM agents face substantial challenges in rule reasoning over complex scenarios. We make our code and dataset publicly available at https://github.com/yuan247/RuleTrek{RuleTrek}.
translation:
标题：RuleTrek：复杂场景下智能体规则推理基准测试

摘要：大语言模型（LLMs）日益擅长处理专业领域中复杂的现实世界任务。然而，当场景信息分散在多个文件中时，识别并正确应用领域特定规则仍然具有挑战性。现有的规则推理基准测试通常仅用少量事实陈述来表示场景，简化了相关规则的识别与应用。为弥补这一不足，本文提出了RuleTrek，一个面向复杂场景下智能体规则推理的多领域基准测试。其基于规则的构建流程提取结构化规则图，生成并增量组合规则特定的子场景，同时确保一致性和可解性。为了系统评估复杂场景下的智能体规则推理能力，RuleTrek在交互式工作空间中评估三项能力：规则识别（RI）、规则演绎（RD）和端到端规则推理（E2E）。在11个前沿LLM上的实验表明，最高的RI和RD得分分别仅为62.47%和60.43%，而E2E得分范围为26.97%至55.29%。这些结果表明，当前LLM智能体在复杂场景的规则推理方面面临重大挑战。我们将代码和数据集公开于https://github.com/yuan247/RuleTrek{RuleTrek}。

title: SwarmRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Scientific Agent Swarm
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) in scientific research aims to improve agents' research capabilities through their own experimental experience. Scientific agent swarms can combine evidence and implementations from different research directions to guide their agents' subsequent experiments. However, poor experimental results can leave unclear whether to revise a hypothesis or its implementation, while overall program scores can hide components useful to other agents. To address these challenges, we introduce SwarmRSI, a framework that evolves scientific agent swarms for recursive self-improvement. We devise Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation to refine hypotheses and their implementations using experimental feedback from other agents. We also propose Complementary Swarm Recombination to reuse retained hypotheses and complementary program components across agents, allowing partial results to support new research. Recursive Swarm Evolution integrates both mechanisms into a feedback loop, using new experimental evidence to guide subsequent research. Experiments on OpenProblems, NatureBench and MLE-Bench Lite demonstrate SwarmRSI's state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance. Further evaluations show that accumulated research experience improves performance on held-out tasks. Biologists also reproduce its programs for follow-up biological analyses.
translation:
标题：SwarmRSI：通过演化科学智能体集群实现递归自我改进

摘要：科学研究中的递归自我改进（RSI）旨在借助智能体自身的实验经验提升其研究能力。科学智能体集群能够融合来自不同研究方向的证据与实现方案，以指导智能体后续实验。然而，当实验结果不佳时，往往难以判断应当修正假设还是其实现；同时，整体程序评分可能掩盖对其他智能体有用的组件。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 SwarmRSI，一个通过演化科学智能体集群实现递归自我改进的框架。我们设计了反馈引导的集群变异（Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation），利用来自其他智能体的实验反馈来优化假设及其实现。我们还提出互补集群重组（Complementary Swarm Recombination），以复用保留的假设以及跨智能体的互补程序组件，从而使部分结果能够支持新的研究。递归集群演化（Recursive Swarm Evolution）将这两种机制整合为反馈循环，利用新的实验证据指导后续研究。在 OpenProblems、NatureBench 和 MLE-Bench Lite 上的实验表明，SwarmRSI 具有当前最优（SOTA）性能。进一步的评估显示，积累的研究经验能够提升其在留出任务上的表现。生物学家也复现了其程序，以开展后续生物学分析。

title: τ-Emotion-Bench: Exposing the Interaction Fragility of LLM Agents through Real-World User Emotions
summary: In long-horizon tool-calling tasks, LLM agents can fail not only because of tool-use errors, but also because of ineffective interaction with users. Yet existing benchmarks largely assume cooperative and behaviorally stable users, leaving the effect of emotional variation on agent reliability underexplored. We introduce τ-Emotion-Bench, a ten-domain benchmark for evaluating tool-calling agents under controlled emotion-conditioned user interactions while preserving the underlying task objective. To scale both benchmark construction and agent training, we introduce Tracer, a scalable agentic data-generation pipeline that constructs grounded, policy-valid tasks and collects trajectories through an interactive agent--user--environment harness. By allowing dissatisfied users to terminate inefficient interactions, the harness provides an interaction-aware signal that filters trajectories with excessive user dependence and favors effective tool use. Experiments with two user simulators show that frontier agents remain unreliable, with substantial gaps between average task success and consistent task completion. Tracer-generated supervision consistently improves Qwen3 models across scales, generalizes to unseen domains, and transfers to τ-Bench and τ-Trait. Behavioral analyses further show that higher task success is associated with a better balance between tool execution and necessary user follow-up. Overall, τ-Emotion-Bench and Tracer provide a scalable framework for evaluating agent reliability under diverse user behaviors and improving tool-calling agents through interaction-aware supervision.
translation:
标题：τ-Emotion-Bench：通过真实世界用户情绪揭示 LLM 智能体的交互脆弱性

摘要：在长时程工具调用任务中，LLM 智能体的失败不仅可能源于工具使用错误，也可能源于与用户的无效交互。然而，现有基准大多假设用户具有合作性且行为稳定，导致情绪变化对智能体可靠性的影响尚未得到充分探索。我们提出 τ-Emotion-Bench，这是一个涵盖十个领域的基准，用于在保留底层任务目标的同时，评估工具调用智能体在受控的情绪条件化用户交互下的表现。为了规模化基准构建与智能体训练，我们提出 Tracer，一种可扩展的智能体式数据生成流水线，用于构建有依据且符合策略的任务，并通过交互式智能体—用户—环境框架收集轨迹。通过允许不满意的用户终止低效交互，该框架提供了一种交互感知信号，可过滤过度依赖用户的轨迹，并倾向于有效的工具使用。使用两个用户模拟器进行的实验表明，前沿智能体仍不可靠，平均任务成功率与一致任务完成率之间存在显著差距。Tracer 生成的监督信号在不同规模上持续提升 Qwen3 模型，可泛化到未见领域，并可迁移至 τ-Bench 和 τ-Trait。行为分析进一步表明，更高的任务成功率与工具执行和必要用户跟进之间更好的平衡相关。总体而言，τ-Emotion-Bench 和 Tracer 提供了一个可扩展框架，用于评估多样用户行为下的智能体可靠性，并通过交互感知监督改进工具调用智能体。

title: RAR: Rate-Adaptive Rollout for Time-Consistent Interactive World Models
summary: Video-based interactive world models aim to enable real-time, user-controllable environments. Yet most existing systems are trained and rolled out at a fixed temporal rate, limiting both runtime-rate adaptation and physical-horizon coverage -- a limitation we term temporal-rate coupling. Specifically, when runtime generation throughput differs from the learned temporal rate, the generated world evolves unintentionally more slowly or quickly. Moreover, using a single temporal rate imposes an inherent trade-off between temporal granularity and physical horizon: higher rates capture finer motion but cover a shorter duration under a fixed context window. To address both limitations, we introduce Rate-Adaptive Rollout (RAR), a framework that enables interactive world models to roll out at controllable temporal rates. At its core, Stride-RoPE aligns latent frames sampled at different rates on a shared physical-time coordinate, enabling consistent multi-rate rollout, unseen-rate generalization, and online rate switching without discarding history. Meanwhile, RAR uses multi-stride video sampling to enable joint learning of fine-grained dynamics and long-horizon evolution. Across action- and camera-controlled environments, RAR achieves temporally consistent multi-rate rollout and online rate switching while preserving high-rate generation quality and extending physical horizons under matched training budgets. RAR also transfers to pretrained world models while preserving perceptual quality.
translation:
标题：RAR：面向时间一致交互式世界模型的速率自适应推演

摘要：基于视频的交互式世界模型旨在实现实时、用户可控的环境。然而，大多数现有系统以固定时间速率进行训练和推演，限制了运行时速率自适应与物理时域覆盖——我们将这一局限称为时间速率耦合。具体而言，当运行时生成吞吐量与所学时间速率不匹配时，生成的世界会无意中演化得更慢或更快。此外，使用单一时间速率会在时间粒度与物理时域之间造成固有权衡：较高时间速率可捕捉更精细的运动，但在固定上下文窗口下覆盖的持续时间更短。为解决上述两个局限，我们提出速率自适应推演（Rate-Adaptive Rollout, RAR）框架，使交互式世界模型能够以可控的时间速率进行推演。其核心是 Stride-RoPE，它将不同速率采样的潜在帧对齐到共享的物理时间坐标上，从而实现一致的多速率推演、未见速率泛化，以及在不丢弃历史的情况下进行在线速率切换。同时，RAR 使用多步幅视频采样，以联合学习细粒度动态与长时程演化。在动作控制和相机控制的环境中，RAR 在匹配训练预算下实现了时间一致的多速率推演和在线速率切换，同时保持高时间速率生成质量并扩展物理时域。RAR 还可迁移至预训练世界模型，同时保持感知质量。

title: SkillMarker: A KGW-Based Watermarking Method for Agent Skill Ownership Verification
summary: Agent skills encode operational procedures and domain expertise as reusable knowledge assets, yet their distribution in plaintext exposes them to unauthorized copying and leakage. However, practical mechanisms for skill ownership verification and leakage tracing remain underdeveloped. Watermark embedding before distribution offers a potential solution, but structured, compact skill instructions impose stringent requirements for factual and procedural accuracy. To address these challenges, we introduce SkillMarker, a KGW-based watermarking method that jointly targets functionality preservation and strong watermark embedding. SkillMarker unifies quality-constrained rewriting with signal-oriented candidate search. The former separates essential knowledge from flexible expression to preserve instruction fidelity; the latter explores alternative expressions to obtain a stronger watermark signal under preservation constraints. We release an open-source toolkit that integrates watermark embedding, quality auditing, and detection to support the protection of agent skills. SkillMarker targets ownership verification and leakage tracing in distributed skill ecosystems, where content may be copied in whole or in part, or incorporated into other skills.
translation:
标题：SkillMarker：一种基于KGW的智能体技能所有权验证水印方法

摘要：智能体技能将操作流程与领域专业知识编码为可复用的知识资产，然而其以明文形式分发使其面临未经授权复制与泄露的风险。然而，用于技能所有权验证与泄露追溯的实用机制仍不完善。在分发前嵌入水印提供了一种潜在解决方案，但结构化、紧凑的技能指令对事实准确性和流程准确性提出了严格要求。为应对这些挑战，我们提出SkillMarker，一种基于KGW的水印方法，同时面向功能保持与强水印嵌入。SkillMarker将质量约束改写与信号导向候选搜索相统一。前者将核心知识与灵活表达分离以保持指令保真度；后者在保持约束下探索替代表达以获得更强水印信号。我们发布了一个开源工具包，集成水印嵌入、质量审计与检测，以支持智能体技能保护。SkillMarker面向分布式技能生态系统中的所有权验证与泄露追溯，其中内容可能被整体或部分复制，或被整合到其他技能中。

title: GroundGUI: GUI Grounding by High-Quality Data and Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning
summary: Constructing robust GUI agents relies on multimodal visual grounding: the ability to precisely map natural language intents to actionable on-screen components. Despite abundant desktop, web, and mobile benchmarks, high-fidelity resources tailored for diverse environments are surprisingly scarce. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Screen Referring Grounding Dataset (ScreenRef), a comprehensive GUI grounding dataset consisting of GUI screenshots paired with natural language referring expressions and box or point annotations. Spanning desktop, web, and mobile domains, ScreenRef comprises 586K screenshots and over 633K referring expression instances, covering tasks such as text recognition, visual matching, spatial understanding, and refusal scenarios. To boost the model's grounding performance, we propose the Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning (D2RL) method to address the limited generalization of supervised fine-tuning and the sparse reward problem in reinforcement learning. Utilizing ScreenRef, we train Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct via sequential SFT and D2RL training, yielding GroundGUI-8B. GroundGUI-8B achieves 95.2% on ScreenSpot-V2, 63.9% on ScreenSpot-Pro, 65.4% on OSWorld-G, 86.8% on MMBench-GUI L2, and 38.3% on UI-Vision. Among 8B-scale models, it produces substantial gains over models trained on open-source datasets, with performance comparable or even superior to models trained on closed-source data. Code, models, and datasets are available at https://github.com/PrentisAI/GroundGUI.
translation:
标题：GroundGUI：通过高质量数据与从蒸馏到强化学习实现GUI定位

摘要：构建鲁棒的GUI智能体依赖于多模态视觉定位能力：即将自然语言意图精确映射到屏幕上的可操作组件。尽管桌面端、网页端和移动端基准资源丰富，但针对多样化环境定制的高保真资源却出奇稀缺。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了屏幕指代定位数据集（ScreenRef），这是一个全面的GUI定位数据集，由GUI截图与自然语言指代表达及框或点标注配对组成。ScreenRef涵盖桌面端、网页端和移动端领域，包含58.6万张截图和超过63.3万个指代表达实例，覆盖文本识别、视觉匹配、空间理解和拒绝场景等任务。为提升模型的定位性能，我们提出了从蒸馏到强化学习（D2RL）方法，以解决监督微调泛化能力有限以及强化学习中奖励稀疏的问题。利用ScreenRef，我们通过顺序SFT和D2RL训练对Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct进行训练，得到GroundGUI-8B。GroundGUI-8B在ScreenSpot-V2上达到95.2%，在ScreenSpot-Pro上达到63.9%，在OSWorld-G上达到65.4%，在MMBench-GUI L2上达到86.8%，在UI-Vision上达到38.3%。在8B规模模型中，其相较于在开源数据集上训练的模型取得了显著提升，性能与在闭源数据上训练的模型相当甚至更优。代码、模型和数据集可在https://github.com/PrentisAI/GroundGUI获取。

title: ProgAgent: Learning Tool Orchestration through Programmatic Training
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly expected to orchestrate diverse tools over long-horizon tasks. Existing agents typically use Direct Tool Calling (DTC), where the model invokes tools sequentially, and tool responses accumulate in the model context, which can lead to context rot and orchestration breakdown. In contrast, Programmatic Tool Calling (PTC) invokes tools through executable code and stores intermediate results in runtime variables rather than appending them to the context. Prior work has explored PTC mainly as an inference-time optimization, but its benefits for agentic training remain unclear, and suitable verifiable training tasks are scarce. In this work, we introduce ProgAgent, a full PTC training stack, comprising a pipeline for synthesizing verifiable long-horizon tasks, a lightweight PTC runtime, and a two-stage training recipe. Using only 215 tasks instantiated at four environment scales, ProgAgent yields higher pass rates than the evaluated baselines of comparable size across four benchmarks. On LOCA-bench, ProgAgent-14B achieves a 30.7% pass rate at a 64k-token environment state, where these baselines score zero. Cross-harness experiments show that PTC-trained models outperform DTC-trained models under both evaluation interfaces, suggesting that the benefits of PTC training extend beyond the interface.
translation:
标题：ProgAgent：通过程序化训练学习工具编排

摘要：大语言模型（LLM）日益需要在长时程任务中编排多种工具。现有智能体通常采用直接工具调用（DTC），即模型依次调用工具，工具响应不断累积在模型上下文中，这可能导致上下文腐化与编排崩溃。相比之下，程序化工具调用（PTC）通过可执行代码调用工具，并将中间结果存储在运行时变量中，而非将其追加到上下文中。已有工作主要将PTC作为推理时的优化手段进行探索，但其对智能体训练的益处仍不明确，且合适的可验证训练任务稀缺。在本工作中，我们提出了ProgAgent，一套完整的PTC训练方案，包括可验证长时程任务的合成流水线、轻量级PTC运行时以及两阶段训练配方。仅使用在四种环境规模下实例化的215个任务，ProgAgent在四个基准测试上均取得了高于同等规模评估基线的通过率。在LOCA-bench上，ProgAgent-14B在64k token环境状态下达到了30.7%的通过率，而上述基线在该条件下得分为零。跨框架实验表明，PTC训练的模型在两种评估接口下均优于DTC训练的模型，这表明PTC训练的收益超越了接口本身。

title: Efficient Scene-Text Refinement via Pixel-Space Grouped Image Generation
summary: Generated images often have coherent layouts and visual content, yet local errors in small text and complex characters still limit their readability and practical use. Scene-text refinement requires accuracy, preservation, and efficiency. Existing methods based on variational autoencoders (VAEs) can lose fine strokes during reconstruction, while full-image editing can shift background colors. In this work, we introduce PixText, a model that formulates local text refinement as grouped image generation in pixel space. Conditioned on the original image, PixText generates only the target regions, preserves unedited content, and uses MeanFlow for four-step generation. We further introduce Text Refinement Bench to evaluate text correction and image preservation in generated images. On this benchmark, PixText achieves 83.06% glyph pass and 94.66% exact target-character OCR accuracy, versus 36.77% and 52.31% for the strongest baseline. Its four-step MeanFlow variant retains an 81.84% pass rate with less than one GPU-second of amortized generation cost per image.
translation:
标题：基于像素空间分组图像生成的高效场景文本精修

摘要：生成图像通常具有连贯的布局和视觉内容，但小文本和复杂字符中的局部错误仍会限制其可读性和实际应用。场景文本精修需要兼具准确性、保持性与效率。现有基于变分自编码器（VAE）的方法在重建过程中可能丢失精细笔画，而全图编辑则可能改变背景颜色。在本工作中，我们提出 PixText，一种将局部文本精修建模为像素空间中分组图像生成的模型。以原始图像为条件，PixText 仅生成目标区域，保留未编辑内容，并使用 MeanFlow 进行四步生成。我们进一步提出文本精修基准（Text Refinement Bench），用于评估生成图像中的文本校正和图像保持。在该基准上，PixText 实现了 83.06% 的字形通过率和 94.66% 的目标字符 OCR 精确准确率，而最强基线分别为 36.77% 和 52.31%。其四步 MeanFlow 变体保持 81.84% 的通过率，且每张图像的均摊生成成本低于 1 GPU 秒。

title: Apertus 1.5: From Open Text Models to Open Multimodal Reasoners
summary: Language models are becoming infrastructure, and infrastructure built in the open, by public institutions, on documented data, is the alternative to dependence on a few providers; Apertus shows this is viable at scale. Apertus 1.5 extends the fully open Apertus family from text to multimodal reasoning. Continued pretraining of the Apertus 1.0 models, on 4T additional tokens for the 8B and 2T for the 70B, adds image and audio understanding and extends the context window fourfold to 262,144 tokens; multimodality enters through the tokenizer, the language-model head remains restricted to text, and the architecture is unchanged. Supervised finetuning, long-context finetuning, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, and preference alignment complete the released models. Thinking is a flag of the chat template rather than a separate model, and lifts mathematical reasoning by up to 20 points on the 8B model. The released models improve over their predecessors on nearly every benchmark; among fully open models of its class, the 8B leads on knowledge, instruction following, and cultural benchmarks, and its instruction following surpasses all compared models, including open-weight ones. On image and audio understanding, a first for the family, the models are competitive with fully open multimodal models, strongest on document understanding and long-form and lower-resource speech recognition, while specialized vision and audio models remain ahead on perception and transcription of English and other high-resource languages. As in Apertus 1.0, we train only on openly available data, respect crawler opt-outs retroactively, and exclude restrictively licensed material. We release the model weights, data preparation and training recipes, and evaluation suites under permissive licenses; openness extends to values, with the Apertus charter guiding alignment stages published alongside the models.
translation:
标题：Apertus 1.5：从开放文本模型到开放多模态推理器  
摘要：语言模型正日益成为基础设施，而由公共机构基于有据可查的数据公开构建的基础设施，是摆脱对少数供应商依赖的替代方案；Apertus 表明这在规模化上是可行的。Apertus 1.5 将完全开放的 Apertus 系列从文本扩展到多模态推理。对 Apertus 1.0 模型进行继续预训练（8B 模型额外使用 4T 个 token，70B 模型额外使用 2T 个 token），增加了图像和音频理解能力，并将上下文窗口扩展四倍至 262,144 个 token；多模态性通过分词器引入，语言模型头仍限于文本，架构保持不变。监督微调、长上下文微调、带可验证奖励的强化学习以及偏好对齐完成了最终发布的模型。Thinking 是聊天模板的一个标志位，而非单独模型，并在 8B 模型上将数学推理提升最多 20 分。发布的模型在几乎所有基准上均优于前代；在其同类的完全开放模型中，8B 模型在知识、指令遵循和文化基准上领先，其指令遵循能力超过所有对比模型，包括开放权重模型。在图像和音频理解方面，这是该系列首次具备的能力，模型与完全开放的多模态模型相比具有竞争力，在文档理解以及长格式和低资源语音识别方面表现最强；而专用视觉和音频模型在英语及其他高资源语言的感知和转写方面仍保持领先。与 Apertus 1.0 一样，我们仅基于公开可用的数据训练，追溯性地尊重爬虫退出选择，并排除许可受限的材料。我们以宽松许可证发布模型权重、数据准备与训练配方以及评估套件；开放性还延伸至价值观：用于指导对齐阶段的 Apertus 章程随模型一同发布。

title: Diagnosing and Correcting Reward Hacking in Verifiable Instruction Following
summary: Verifiable instruction-following benchmarks emphasize output-constraint satisfaction but can overlook whether responses meaningfully answer the underlying request, creating an evaluation blind spot. We show that frontier models can receive full credit for responses with little substantive answer content. Using the same verifier-based criterion as a training reward can induce reward hacking, as publicly released checkpoints exhibit higher constraint satisfaction but lower response quality after reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. To address this reward hacking, we introduce CALIF, a lightweight method that augments verifier rewards with a calibrated likelihood-based bonus to preserve response quality. CALIF evaluates response likelihood under the request alone using the existing frozen reference policy, requiring no additional judge or learned reward model. Across models ranging from 1.7B to 8B in reasoning and non-reasoning modes, CALIF improves constraint satisfaction on IFBench while maintaining response quality near or above pre-RL levels. It also outperforms corresponding base policies in 40 of 45 model-metric comparisons across three rubric-based instruction-following benchmarks, demonstrating gains beyond training verifiers.
translation:
标题：诊断并纠正可验证指令遵循中的奖励黑客行为

摘要：可验证的指令遵循基准强调对输出约束的满足，但可能忽视回答是否实质性地回应了其背后的请求，从而形成评估盲区。我们表明，前沿模型可以因几乎没有实质性回答内容的响应而获得满分。将同样的基于验证器的标准用作训练奖励可能诱发奖励黑客行为，因为公开发布的检查点在使用可验证奖励进行强化学习后，表现出更高的约束满足度，但响应质量更低。为解决这种奖励黑客行为，我们提出 CALIF，一种轻量级方法，它通过加入一个校准的基于似然的奖励加成项来增补验证器奖励，以保持响应质量。CALIF 使用现有的冻结参考策略，仅在给定请求的条件下评估响应似然，无需额外的评判器或学习到的奖励模型。在从 1.7B 到 8B 的推理与非推理模式模型中，CALIF 提高了 IFBench 上的约束满足度，同时将响应质量保持在接近或高于强化学习前水平。在三个基于评分标准的指令遵循基准上，它在 45 项模型-指标比较中的 40 项中优于相应的基础策略，表明其收益超越了训练验证器。

title: Are We Testing Too Much? A Survey of Benchmark Compression for Efficient Evaluation of Large Language Models
summary: Benchmarks are essential for evaluating and improving large language models (LLMs). Yet many widely used benchmarks are redundant, making evaluation unnecessarily expensive. Benchmark compression lowers this cost by estimating full-benchmark scores and rankings from a partial evaluation. Research in this area has grown rapidly since 2024, but to our knowledge no survey has systematically organized its methods and findings. We review 119 papers to explain how methods choose what to evaluate, recover full-benchmark results, and verify their reliability. From this analysis, we develop a taxonomy covering compression within individual benchmarks, across benchmark suites, and during adaptive evaluation, together with work on redundancy and reliability. We compare their information needs, total costs, reliability checks, and limitations. Methods reduce evaluation costs by selecting representative subsets, using cheaper or reusable information, and testing adaptively, but risk poor coverage, inaccurate estimates, and sequential delays. The resulting taxonomy and practical guide help researchers choose, validate, and deploy methods for more efficient and reliable LLM evaluation.
translation:
标题：我们是否测试过度了？面向大语言模型高效评估的基准压缩综述

摘要：基准测试是评估和改进大语言模型（LLM）的关键手段。然而，许多广泛使用的基准存在冗余，导致评估成本不必要地高昂。基准压缩通过从部分评估中估计完整基准的分数和排名来降低这一成本。自2024年以来，该领域的研究迅速增长，但据我们所知，尚无综述对其方法和发现进行系统性梳理。本文回顾了119篇论文，阐释了各类方法如何选择评估内容、恢复完整基准结果并验证其可靠性。基于这一分析，我们构建了一个分类体系，涵盖单个基准内部、跨基准套件以及自适应评估过程中的压缩，并兼顾冗余与可靠性方面的研究。我们比较了这些方法的信息需求、总成本、可靠性检验及局限性。这些方法通过选取代表性子集、利用更廉价或可复用的信息以及自适应测试来降低评估成本，但也面临覆盖不足、估计不准确和顺序延迟等风险。由此形成的分类体系和实践指南有助于研究人员选择、验证和部署更高效、更可靠的LLM评估方法。

title: Long-Horizon RL Needs Muon
summary: Long-horizon agents must coordinate reasoning, tool use, and environment feedback over extended interactions. Learning from sparse outcome rewards requires weighting trajectories of different lengths and updating the policy while rollouts are still being collected. We examine a single-rollout asynchronous recipe combining Muon, token-averaged loss, truncated importance sampling, and auxiliary length and tool-error penalties. Single-rollout sampling allows asynchronous learning without waiting for multiple trajectories for the same issue. We study optimizer choices and recipe components for repository-level issue resolution across two model families. The evaluated training runs show higher training success with the full recipe than with the baselines.
translation:
标题：长时程强化学习需要 Muon

摘要：长时程智能体必须在扩展交互中协调推理、工具使用和环境反馈。从稀疏结果奖励中学习，需要对不同长度的轨迹进行加权，并在 rollout 仍在收集时更新策略。我们考察了一种单 rollout 异步配方，其结合了 Muon、按 token 平均的损失、截断重要性采样，以及辅助性的长度与工具错误惩罚。单 rollout 采样允许异步学习，而无需为同一问题等待多条轨迹。我们在两个模型家族上研究了面向仓库级问题解决的优化器选择与配方组件。所评估的训练运行表明，完整配方的训练成功率高于基线。

title: LLM-to-Flow Distillation: Teaching Natural Language Goals to Scientific Generators
summary: Generative discovery in science requires coupling high-level scientific reasoning with the ability to generate samples respecting the structure of a design space. Yet these capabilities remain largely separated: foundation LLMs encode broad chemical and biological knowledge, while domain-specific flow- and diffusion-based generators capture the priors needed to produce valid sequences and geometries. We study how to align such scientific generators to high-level natural-language discovery goals without requiring an explicit proxy reward, which is often unavailable or poorly captured by learned predictors in experimental sciences. We introduce LLM-to-Flow Distillation (LFD), where a frozen LLM acts as an adaptive teacher for a domain-specific generator. Given a goal such as 'generate peptides with promising anticancer activity', the teacher constructs a curriculum of intermediate sub-goals aware of the flow's current capabilities, and progressively directs them toward the original discovery goal. At each round, the LLM judges sampled candidates under the current objective. These judgments induce preferences that are iteratively distilled into the generator through DPO. This procedure provides dense learning signals even when the initial model places negligible probability on designs satisfying the final goal, enabling adaptation toward poorly covered, out-of-distribution regions. Experiments on therapeutic peptides and small-molecule structure design demonstrate that LFD enables a new form of generative control: aligning arbitrary domain-specific scientific generators to scientific discovery tasks expressed via high-level natural-language goals.
translation:
标题：LLM到流蒸馏：将自然语言目标教授给科学生成器

摘要：科学中的生成式发现要求将高层次的科学推理与生成符合设计空间结构样本的能力相结合。然而，这两种能力在很大程度上仍然相互分离：基础大语言模型编码了广泛的化学和生物学知识，而领域特定的基于流和扩散的生成器则捕获了生成有效序列和几何结构所需的先验。我们研究如何将此类科学生成器与高层次自然语言发现目标对齐，而无需依赖显式的代理奖励——在实验科学中，这种奖励往往不可获得，或难以被学习到的预测器充分捕捉。我们提出LLM到流蒸馏（LFD），其中冻结的LLM充当领域特定生成器的自适应教师。给定诸如“生成具有前景良好的抗癌活性的肽”这样的目标，教师构建一个感知流模型当前能力的中间子目标课程，并逐步将其导向原始发现目标。在每一轮中，LLM根据当前目标对采样候选进行评估。这些评估产生偏好信号，并通过DPO迭代地蒸馏到生成器中。即使初始模型对满足最终目标的设计赋予的概率微乎其微，该过程也能提供密集的学习信号，从而实现对覆盖不足的分布外区域的适应。在治疗性肽和小分子结构设计上的实验表明，LFD实现了一种新形式的生成控制：将任意领域特定的科学生成器与通过高层次自然语言目标表达的科学发现任务相对齐。

title: SafeDriveVLA: Navigation-Conditioned World Model Dreaming for Conflict-Aware End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are gaining attention in autonomous driving, inheriting commonsense priors from large language models (LLMs) and widening the navigation interface from a fixed command set to free-form natural-language instructions. However, this open-ended interface exposes a new vulnerability surface: an inattentive driver may issue instructions that are unsafe given the current scene, and a malicious user may issue dangerous ones on purpose. We present the first benchmark suite that evaluates navigation following and conflict awareness together, along with adversarial robustness. Existing VLAs fall short on both: SimLingo completes no language-instructed lane change in closed loop, and all models degrade sharply under conflicting signals. We propose SafeDriveVLA, the first driving VLA that (1) explicitly predicts a three-level navigation-compliance mode to decouple conflict reasoning from action generation, and (2) uses navigation-conditioned world model dreaming to inform this prediction. Unlike prior world models that roll out expert or planned actions, ours dreams of strictly following the navigation signal, showing when following is safe. SafeDriveVLA reaches 88.16 Driving Score (DS) and 68.64% Success Rate (SR) on Bench2Drive, lifts closed-loop language following by 49.3% and reduces collisions under unsafe instructions from 60 to 38 compared to the best SimLingo variant. Video demonstrations are available on our project page.
translation:
标题：SafeDriveVLA：面向冲突感知端到端自动驾驶的导航条件化世界模型推演

摘要：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在自动驾驶领域日益受到关注，其从大语言模型（LLM）中继承常识先验，并将导航接口从固定指令集扩展至自由形式的自然语言指令。然而，这一开放式接口暴露了新的脆弱性面：疏忽的驾驶员可能发出在当前场景下不安全的指令，恶意用户则可能故意发出危险指令。我们提出了首个同时评估导航跟随与冲突感知能力以及对抗鲁棒性的基准测试套件。现有VLA模型在这两方面均表现不足：SimLingo在闭环中无法完成任何语言指令指定的车道变更，且所有模型在冲突信号下性能均急剧下降。我们提出SafeDriveVLA，这是首个驾驶VLA模型，其特点包括：（1）显式预测三级导航遵从模式，将冲突推理与动作生成解耦；（2）利用导航条件化世界模型推演为该预测提供信息。与先前推演专家或规划动作的世界模型不同，我们的模型推演严格遵循导航信号的情形，展示何时跟随是安全的。SafeDriveVLA在Bench2Drive上达到88.16的驾驶评分（DS）和68.64%的成功率（SR），相较于最佳SimLingo变体，闭环语言跟随能力提升49.3%，不安全指令下的碰撞次数从60降至38。视频演示详见我们的项目主页。

title: Acting Through Registers
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) use generative visual representations to condition robot actions, yet how these representations organize action-relevant information remains poorly understood. We identify persistent high-norm spatial outliers in WAM representations and find that their action relevance persists even after normalization and K/V projection attenuate their extreme magnitude. Motivated by this observation, we introduce RegisterWAM, which adds learnable non-spatial registers to the world model and uses them directly for action conditioning. Registers alone do not fully eliminate spatial outliers; pairing them with observation flow-matching (FM) loss supervision suppresses spatial outliers while concentrating high-norm responses in registers. Beyond this reorganization, observation FM loss supervision also improves action learning without registers, motivating an additional noised-observation FM objective that learns current-scene recovery from corrupted inputs. The resulting model achieves 81.64\% success on LIBERO-Plus without additional embodied pretraining data or foundation models, reaches 93.0\% average success on RoboTwin 2.0, and improves real-world manipulation performance.
translation:
标题：通过寄存器执行动作

摘要：世界动作模型（WAMs）利用生成式视觉表示来调节机器人动作，然而这些表示如何组织与动作相关的信息仍鲜为人知。我们在WAM表示中识别出持续存在的高范数空间离群值，并发现即使在归一化和K/V投影削弱其极端幅值之后，它们与动作的相关性仍然存在。受此观察启发，我们提出了RegisterWAM，它在世界模型中添加可学习的非空间寄存器，并直接将其用于动作调节。仅靠寄存器并不能完全消除空间离群值；将其与观测流匹配（FM）损失监督相结合，可抑制空间离群值，同时将高范数响应集中于寄存器中。除了这种重组之外，观测FM损失监督还能在没有寄存器的情况下改善动作学习，从而促成了一个额外的加噪观测FM目标，即从损坏输入中学习当前场景恢复。最终模型在无需额外具身预训练数据或基础模型的情况下，在LIBERO-Plus上达到81.64%的成功率，在RoboTwin 2.0上达到93.0%的平均成功率，并提升了真实世界操作性能。

title: Glance Forcing: Making Bidirectional Diffusion Autoregressive at a Glance
summary: Autoregressive generation underlies real-time, causal video synthesis and is the backbone of video world models. Today's dominant approach distills a bidirectional diffusion model into a causal few-step student, but existing pipelines make this conversion prohibitively expensive, requiring offline Probability Flow ODE} (PF-ODE) trajectories that cost tens of thousands of GPU-hours and terabytes of storage. We show it can be made dramatically more efficient. Pushing this efficiency to its extreme, we reduce trajectory supervision to a single sample, the strictest setting possible, and find that it causes severe quality collapse. We trace this to the teacher's trajectory geometry: the high-noise regime, governing semantic layout and motion, and the low-noise regime, governing fine texture exhibit fundamentally different curvature and optimization behavior, so a single monolithic student cannot jointly fit both, causing severe representation interference. Motivated by this, we propose Glance Forcing, a lightweight distillation framework that decouples the denoising trajectory into two complementary slow and fast experts, each guided by a tailored, stage-specific objective, while keeping the pretrained teacher entirely frozen. This decoupling further reveals a general mechanism underlying few-step distillation: PF-ODE distillation mainly straightens the few-step trajectory geometry, while the subsequent distribution-matching stage independently governs distributional quality. Using only one PF-ODE trajectory, Glance Forcing already surpasses the fully-trained state-of-the-art baseline, raising the VBench Total score from 84.04 to 84.22 while cutting trajectory-collection cost from thousands of GPU-hours to about one A100-GPU-hour, with markedly larger gains in dynamic degree, VisionReward, and instruction-following, and consistent preference from human raters over strong baselines.
translation:
标题：Glance Forcing：让双向扩散模型一瞥之间实现自回归  
摘要：自回归生成是实时、因果视频合成的基础，也是视频世界模型的骨干。当前主流方法将双向扩散模型蒸馏为因果少步学生模型，但现有流程使这一转换成本高得难以承受，需要离线概率流常微分方程（PF-ODE）轨迹，耗费数万 GPU 小时和数 TB 存储。我们表明，这一过程可以被显著提升效率。将效率推向极致，我们将轨迹监督缩减为单个样本——这是可能的最严格设定——并发现它会导致严重的质量塌陷。我们将其归因于教师的轨迹几何：高噪声区间主导语义布局与运动，低噪声区间主导精细纹理，二者表现出根本不同的曲率和优化行为，因此单一整体式学生模型无法同时拟合二者，从而导致严重的表征干扰。受此启发，我们提出 Glance Forcing，一种轻量级蒸馏框架，将去噪轨迹解耦为两个互补的慢专家和快专家，每个专家由定制的、阶段特定目标引导，同时保持预训练教师完全冻结。这种解耦进一步揭示了少步蒸馏背后的一般机制：PF-ODE 蒸馏主要拉直少步轨迹几何，而随后的分布匹配阶段独立控制分布质量。仅使用一条 PF-ODE 轨迹，Glance Forcing 便已超越完全训练的最先进基线，将 VBench 总分从 84.04 提升至 84.22，同时将轨迹收集成本从数千 GPU 小时降至约一个 A100 GPU 小时，并在动态程度、VisionReward 和指令遵循方面取得显著更大提升，且在人类评分者中相较强基线获得一致偏好。

title: Joint Subspace Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Decoding
summary: Sparse attention reduces the KV-cache traffic that dominates long-context LLM decoding, but practical methods largely operate at coarse granularity. Token-level selection offers finer control, yet presents two challenges: low-dimensional scoring may lose query--key structure needed for accurate ranking, while gathering scattered selected tokens can offset the resulting latency benefit. We introduce Joint Subspace Sparse Attention (JSSA) to address both challenges. For selection quality, JSSA learns a shared low-dimensional query--key subspace by minimizing token-score preservation error. We upper-bound the resulting non-convex objective with a tractable marginal objective that admits a closed-form spectral solution; direct refinement of the exact objective provides no measurable improvement in the tested settings. For execution efficiency, we develop a gather-free token-level indexed-attention kernel that supports distinct per-KV-head selections under the standard grouped-query attention (GQA) KV-cache layout. Across standard GQA, hybrid sliding-window/global attention, and Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) models, JSSA consistently remains close to full-KV accuracy while avoiding the substantial generation-length inflation and architecture-dependent failures observed with competing methods. On an NVIDIA B200 GPU, JSSA achieves up to 6.43times the decoding throughput of full-KV attention at 128K context. JSSA achieves reasoning accuracy comparable to model-native DSA without model training and reaches 96--99\% of its decoding throughput even at 700B scale large models.
translation:
标题：面向高效长上下文解码的联合子空间稀疏注意力

摘要：稀疏注意力降低了在长上下文 LLM 解码中占主导的 KV 缓存访存流量，但实用方法大多在粗粒度上运行。词元级选择提供了更细粒度的控制，却带来两个挑战：低维打分可能丢失准确排序所需的查询--键结构，而聚集分散的所选词元又会抵消由此获得的延迟收益。我们提出联合子空间稀疏注意力（JSSA）以同时应对这两个挑战。在选择质量方面，JSSA 通过最小化词元分数保持误差来学习一个共享的低维查询--键子空间。我们用一个可处理的边缘目标对由此产生的非凸目标进行上界约束，该边缘目标具有闭式谱解；在测试设置中，直接对精确目标进行细化并未带来可测量的提升。在执行效率方面，我们开发了一种免聚集的词元级索引注意力内核，可在标准分组查询注意力（GQA）KV 缓存布局下支持针对每个 KV 头的不同选择。在标准 GQA、混合滑动窗口/全局注意力以及多头潜在注意力（MLA）模型中，JSSA 始终接近全 KV 精度，同时避免了竞争方法中出现的显著生成长度膨胀和架构相关的失效。在 NVIDIA B200 GPU 上，JSSA 在 128K 上下文下的解码吞吐量最高可达全 KV 注意力的 6.43 倍。JSSA 无需模型训练即可达到与模型原生 DSA 相当的推理精度，并且即使在 700B 规模的大模型上，其解码吞吐量也能达到模型原生 DSA 的 96%--99%。

title: VITAL: From Visual Motion to Precise Action
summary: World-action models aim to turn visual anticipation into driving decisions, yet typically train action experts on trajectory representations defined independently of visual dynamics. This motivates deriving action targets directly from visual motion. We first examine a simpler setting in which trajectories are reconstructed from recorded future images. Even without the need for future prediction, reconstruction captures the dominant maneuver but leaves centimeter-scale errors. We therefore introduce VITAL (Vision-Induced Tokens for Action Learning), an action tokenizer that couples a visually derived motion scaffold with a compact residual encoding the trajectory error left by that scaffold. This representation makes visual motion the principal prediction target and gives small metric corrections a separate, normalized learning scale. Using flow matching, the action expert jointly predicts both components from the current image, ego state, and navigation command, without generating future images at inference. The same residual coordinates support bounded reinforcement post-training that refines execution while keeping the predicted visual scaffold fixed. With only one action denoising step, VITAL achieves 90.8 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 navtest, within 0.13 points of its ten-step score at 3.29x the end-to-end inference speed. Without retraining, it achieves 91.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 navtest and 38.6 on navhard. Project page: https://worldbench.github.io/vital
translation:
标题：VITAL：从视觉运动到精确动作

摘要：世界-动作模型旨在将视觉预判转化为驾驶决策，但通常是在独立于视觉动态定义的轨迹表示上训练动作专家。这促使我们直接从视觉运动中导出动作目标。我们首先考察一个更简单的设定：从记录的未来图像中重建轨迹。即使不需要未来预测，重建也能捕捉主导机动动作，但会留下厘米级误差。因此，我们提出 VITAL（Vision-Induced Tokens for Action Learning，用于动作学习的视觉诱导标记），这是一种动作标记器，将视觉导出的运动支架与一个紧凑残差耦合起来，该残差编码该支架遗留的轨迹误差。这种表示使视觉运动成为主要预测目标，并为小幅度量修正赋予单独且归一化的学习尺度。使用流匹配，动作专家从当前图像、自车状态和导航指令中联合预测这两个分量，而推理时无需生成未来图像。相同的残差坐标支持有界强化后训练，可在保持预测视觉支架固定的同时改进执行。仅需一个动作去噪步骤，VITAL 在 NAVSIM v1 navtest 上达到 90.8 PDMS，与其十步得分相差不到 0.13 分，而端到端推理速度为十步推理的 3.29 倍。无需重新训练，它在 NAVSIM v2 navtest 上达到 91.1 EPDMS，并在 navhard 上达到 38.6。项目页面：https://worldbench.github.io/vital

title: TextVerifier: Seeing Beyond Recognition to Verify Chinese Text Rendering
summary: Text-to-image models increasingly generate readable Chinese text that still contains local rendering defects, such as a character with an extra or missing stroke or a malformed component. Such errors are invisible to OCR and vision-language models, which are trained for recognition and are therefore invariant to the very structural deviations that define a rendering error. We formalize text rendering verification as a target-conditioned problem: given a target character and an image crop, decide whether the crop is a correct rendering of that character. Our verifier TEXTVERIFIER feeds the text tower a character's Ideographic Description Sequence (IDS) rather than a single-character symbol, and is trained on 12.7M crop-IDS pairs plus label-free "same-character, different-quality" hard pairs sampled from the training trajectory of a text-region inpainting model. To evaluate this ability we build TEXTRENDERBENCH-ZH, the first per-character benchmark for generated Chinese text, annotating position, identity, and correctness for 7,358 characters. TEXTVERIFIER reaches an F1 of 0.844, far above OCR confidence (0.526), a general VLM (0.329), and TextPecker (0.590). Used as a per-character reward for Flow-GRPO post-training, it further reduces rendering errors, showing that its score can both detect and correct errors.
translation:
标题：TextVerifier：超越识别，验证中文文本渲染

摘要：文本到图像模型日益能够生成可读的中文文本，但仍存在局部渲染缺陷，例如某个字符多一笔或少一笔，或部件畸形。此类错误对OCR和视觉语言模型而言是不可见的，因为这些模型是为识别而训练的，因而对界定渲染错误的结构性偏差具有不变性。我们将文本渲染验证形式化为一个目标条件问题：给定目标字符和图像裁剪区域，判定该裁剪区域是否是该字符的正确渲染。我们的验证器TEXTVERIFIER向文本塔输入字符的表意文字描述序列（IDS）而非单字符符号，并在1270万对裁剪-IDS数据对以及从文本区域修复模型的训练轨迹中采样的无标签“同字符、不同质量”难例对上进行了训练。为评估这一能力，我们构建了TEXTRENDERBENCH-ZH，这是首个针对生成中文文本的逐字符基准，标注了7，358个字符的位置、身份和正确性。TEXTVERIFIER达到了0.844的F1值，远高于OCR置信度（0.526）、通用VLM（0.329）和TextPecker（0.590）。将其用作Flow-GRPO后训练的逐字符奖励，可进一步减少渲染错误，表明其评分既能检测错误也能纠正错误。

title: What Makes a Social Agent's Interactions Effective? Learning from Verifiable Outcomes in Paired Worlds
summary: Effective social interaction requires more than fluent responses: agents must reach plans that fit the participants' needs and circumstances. Existing evaluations of social agents mainly rely on LLM judges that rate the conversation, without checking the resulting plan. We introduce HICO-Bench, a benchmark of 180 everyday coordination scenarios, such as resource allocation, scheduling, and authorization, in which two agents with private information converse and then independently record the plan they agreed on. A program checks Feasibility (the two records match and satisfy both participants' private conditions), and an LLM judge checks Integrity (the conversation supports the recorded plan); passing both is a Verified Success. Each scenario has two versions that share the same public context but differ in one private condition, so the correct plan differs between them. Across thirteen LLMs, 36% of conversations rated highly for goal completion fail Verified Success. To learn from outcomes that arrive only at the end of a conversation, we propose Paired-Credit Policy Optimization (PaCPO). After each turn, PaCPO asks the agent for a tentative plan, checks it in both versions of the scenario, and rewards the turns after which the tentative plans fit their respective versions. PaCPO raises Qwen3-8B's Verified Success from 20.4% to 28.3%.
translation:
标题：什么使社会智能体的交互有效？从配对世界中可验证结果中学习

摘要：有效的社交互动不仅仅需要流畅的回应：智能体必须达成符合参与者需求和情境的方案。现有的社会智能体评估主要依赖大语言模型评判器对对话进行评分，而不检查最终形成的方案。我们提出了HICO-Bench，一个包含180个日常协调场景的基准测试，涵盖资源分配、日程安排和授权等情境。在这些场景中，两个拥有私有信息的智能体进行对话，然后各自独立记录他们商定的方案。程序检查可行性（两份记录一致且满足双方参与者的私有条件），大语言模型评判器检查完整性（对话支持所记录的方案）；两者均通过即为验证成功。每个场景有两个版本，它们共享相同的公共上下文，但在一个私有条件上有所不同，因此正确的方案在两个版本之间也不同。在十三个大语言模型中，36%在目标完成度上获得高评分的对话未能通过验证成功。为了从仅在对话结束时才获得的结果中学习，我们提出了配对信用策略优化（PaCPO）。在每个回合之后，PaCPO要求智能体给出一个暂定方案，在场景的两个版本中检查该方案，并对暂定方案分别符合各自版本的回合给予奖励。PaCPO将Qwen3-8B的验证成功率从20.4%提升至28.3%。

title: StartLux-Decision: AutoThink Decision Models with Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions
summary: We introduce StartLux-Decision, decision models from 0.8B to 27B parameters that combine efficient single-pass prediction with adaptive, confidence-guided reasoning. The Instant models use bidirectional attention in full-attention layers to improve decision accuracy while keeping single-pass inference. The AutoThink models invoke explicit reasoning for uncertain decisions and answer confident cases directly. A three-stage training pipeline establishes shared decision capabilities, specializes the two variants, and equips AutoThink with reasoning through reasoning supervision and reinforcement learning. We introduce Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions (RLCD^2), which uses a frozen model and proper scoring rules to reward improvements in decision probability quality and applies a soft penalty to overlong reasoning traces. RLCD^2 raises the share of reasoning traces that terminate within the generation limit by up to 48 percentage points and cuts average reasoning length by up to 65%, while largely preserving decision accuracy. On the public subset of Decision Index 0.3, the Instant models outperform the strongest evaluated comparable-scale open-weight decision models by 7.4-16.9 points, and the 27B AutoThink model reaches 73.4. We also introduce DecisionPivot, a programmatically verifiable benchmark of computational decisions built from contrast pairs that differ in a single answer-changing detail. On DecisionPivot, AutoThink outperforms its Instant counterparts by 11.5-18.4 points in pair accuracy and leads among evaluated systems. The models run on vLLM, llama.cpp and MLX, with quantized variants for lower memory use.
translation:
标题：StartLux-Decision：基于强化学习、面向校准审慎决策的 AutoThink 决策模型
