摘要：我们提出了 StartLux-Decision，这是一系列参数规模从 0.8B 到 27B 的决策模型，将高效的单遍预测与自适应的、置信度引导的推理相结合。Instant 模型在全注意力层中使用双向注意力，以提高决策准确性，同时保持单遍推理。AutoThink 模型对不确定的决策启动显式推理，对高置信度案例直接作答。一个三阶段训练流程建立了共享决策能力，对两个变体进行专门化，并通过推理监督和强化学习使 AutoThink 具备推理能力。我们提出了面向校准审慎决策的强化学习（RLCD^2），它使用冻结模型和恰当评分规则来奖励决策概率质量的提升，并对过长的推理轨迹施加软惩罚。RLCD^2 将生成限制内终止的推理轨迹比例最多提高 48 个百分点，并将平均推理长度最多缩短 65%，同时基本保持决策准确性。在 Decision Index 0.3 的公开子集上，Instant 模型比所评估的最强同等规模开放权重决策模型高出 7.4–16.9 分，27B AutoThink 模型达到 73.4 分。我们还提出了 DecisionPivot，这是一个可通过程序验证的计算决策基准，由仅在单个会改变答案的细节上不同的对比对构建。在 DecisionPivot 上，AutoThink 在配对准确率上比其 Instant 对应模型高出 11.5–18.4 分，并在所评估系统中领先。这些模型可在 vLLM、llama.cpp 和 MLX 上运行，并提供量化变体以降低内存使用。

title: BigCell: Generating Gigapixel Whole-Slide Images
summary: Whole-slide images (WSIs) are gigapixel-scale digital scans of histopathology tissue and serve as the primary basis for cancer diagnosis. Existing histopathology generative models operate at the patch scale, producing fixed-size tiles of at most 1024times1024 pixels which encompass only a small fraction of the WSI. In contrast, text reports for clinical diagnoses and slide-level diagnostic labels -- the supervision that exists at scale -- operate at the whole-slide level. We present BigCell, the first approach to generate coherent whole-slide histopathology images at native gigapixel resolution. BigCell trains a flow-matching transformer at 2048times2048 pixels on over 120,000 publicly available WSIs spanning multiple organ types. Conditioning on embeddings from pathology foundation models and using an inference-time sliding-window pipeline, BigCell generates coherent images of up to 32,768times32,768 pixels, outperforming prior tile generators on both tile-level and slide-level fidelity metrics. To make gigapixel synthesis practical, we introduce an adaptive scheduling strategy that prioritizes important slide regions, speeding up image generation by over 3\ttimes with minimal quality degradation. Furthermore, we propose the first text-to-image synthesis at 8k resolution by training a separate model that produces dense conditioning grids directly from pathology text reports. We demonstrate that augmenting with synthetic samples improves slide-level few-shot classification performance by up to 18 % over baselines trained on real data.
translation:
标题：BigCell：生成千兆像素全切片图像

摘要：全切片图像（WSIs）是组织病理学组织的千兆像素级数字扫描，是癌症诊断的主要依据。现有组织病理学生成模型在图像块尺度上运行，生成至多 1024×1024 像素的固定尺寸图块，仅涵盖 WSI 的一小部分。相比之下，面向临床诊断的文本报告和切片级诊断标签——即可大规模获取的监督信号——均作用于全切片层面。我们提出 BigCell，这是首个能够在原生千兆像素分辨率下生成连贯全切片组织病理学图像的方法。BigCell 在涵盖多种器官类型的 120,000 多张公开可用 WSI 上，以 2048×2048 像素训练了一个流匹配 Transformer。以病理基础模型的嵌入为条件，并采用推理阶段的滑动窗口流水线，BigCell 可生成高达 32,768×32,768 像素的连贯图像，在图像块级和切片级保真度指标上均优于先前的图块生成器。为使千兆像素合成切实可行，我们引入一种自适应调度策略，优先处理重要的切片区域，在质量下降极小的情况下将图像生成速度提升超过 3 倍。此外，我们通过训练一个单独模型，直接从病理文本报告生成稠密条件网格，提出了首个 8K 分辨率的文本到图像合成方法。我们证明，使用合成样本进行增强，可将切片级小样本分类性能较在真实数据上训练的基线最高提升 18%。

title: SWEeper-Bench: Can Agents Discover Bugs in Interactive Software?
summary: Coding agents increasingly interact with users by generating interactive software on the fly rather than replying in text, yet many bugs in such software reveal themselves only after multi-step interactions. Today, users must discover these bugs and wait for fixes, making the development loop slow and expensive. Existing benchmarks typically assume the bugs have already been identified, leaving agents' ability to find interaction-dependent failures largely unevaluated. We introduce SWEeper-Bench, 200 tasks built from real bug fixes in 200 widely used open-source web applications. Each task gives the agent only the codebase and an open-ended request such as "Find and fix issues in Focalboard's board sharing and membership." Because these bugs are hard to detect from code alone, agents must design interactive tests to uncover them. An agentic verifier then judges each repair by what a user would observe in the browser. The best of 15 frontier agents passes only 59.0% of tasks. Through stage-by-stage analysis of agent trajectories, we show that the biggest bottleneck is identifying the buggy behavior: agents often reach the relevant feature but never trigger the failure or fail to recognize it. SWEeper-Bench measures progress toward agents that close this loop themselves, delivering software that works without waiting for user feedback.
translation:
标题：SWEeper-Bench：智能体能否发现交互式软件中的缺陷？

摘要：编码智能体正日益通过即时生成交互式软件与用户互动，而非以文本形式回复，但此类软件中的许多缺陷仅在多步交互之后才会暴露。如今，用户必须自行发现这些缺陷并等待修复，导致开发循环缓慢且成本高昂。现有基准测试通常假设缺陷已被识别，使得智能体发现依赖于交互的故障的能力在很大程度上未得到评估。我们提出SWEeper-Bench，包含200个任务，均构建自200个广泛使用的开源Web应用中的真实缺陷修复。每个任务仅向智能体提供代码库和一个开放式请求，例如“查找并修复Focalboard看板共享与成员管理中的问题”。由于这些缺陷仅凭代码难以检测，智能体必须设计交互式测试来发现它们。随后，一个智能体验证器根据用户在浏览器中可观察到的现象来评判每次修复。15个前沿智能体中表现最佳者仅通过59.0%的任务。通过对智能体轨迹的逐阶段分析，我们表明最大的瓶颈在于识别缺陷行为：智能体往往能到达相关功能，但从未触发故障或未能识别故障。SWEeper-Bench衡量的是智能体在自主闭环方面取得的进展，即交付无需等待用户反馈即可正常运行的软件。

title: Diff Diffusion: Predicting Edit Paths with Diffusion Models for Efficient Code Editing
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) are appealing for code generation because they can update many tokens in parallel, yet many are optimized for sequence synthesis rather than edit prediction. This setting is poorly matched to modern AI-assisted IDEs, where edit prediction must infer the next code change from recent edits, the current file, and cursor-local context. Such changes are usually sparse and preserve most source tokens, so regenerating a full code segment wastes computation. We propose Diff Diffusion, a diffusion-inspired LLM framework for code editing that predicts edit paths from an original snippet to its revised form. Diff Diffusion represents denoising as structured edit operations, and combines this formulation with multi-stage training and efficient parallel decoding. By focusing computation on changed regions, Diff Diffusion supports accurate low-latency edits and multi-position parallel modification. Across public edit-completion benchmarks, edit-prediction evaluations, and online validation, Diff Diffusion matches or leads autoregressive baselines while delivering 2.78 times faster inference on public edit-completion benchmarks and a 39.0% P50 model-latency reduction in production. This work provides a new modeling perspective for AI applications that require high accuracy and low latency.
translation:
标题：Diff Diffusion：使用扩散模型预测编辑路径以实现高效代码编辑

摘要：扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）因能够并行更新大量 token 而在代码生成中颇具吸引力，但其中许多模型针对序列合成而非编辑预测进行了优化。这种设定与现代 AI 辅助 IDE 并不契合：在这些 IDE 中，编辑预测必须根据近期编辑、当前文件以及光标局部上下文推断下一处代码变更。此类变更通常是稀疏的，并保留大多数源 token，因此重新生成完整代码片段会浪费计算。我们提出 Diff Diffusion，一种受扩散启发的代码编辑大语言模型框架，用于预测从原始代码片段到其修订形式的编辑路径。Diff Diffusion 将去噪表示为结构化编辑操作，并将这一形式化表示与多阶段训练和高效并行解码相结合。通过将计算聚焦于变更区域，Diff Diffusion 支持准确的低延迟编辑和多位置并行修改。在公开编辑补全基准、编辑预测评估和在线验证中，Diff Diffusion 与自回归基线持平或领先，同时在公开编辑补全基准上实现快 2.78 倍的推理，并在生产环境中将 P50 模型延迟降低 39.0%。这项工作为需要高精度和低延迟的 AI 应用提供了一种新的建模视角。

title: Physical Time as a Missing Dimension of Robot Policy Memory Dynamics
summary: Existing robot policy memories typically evolve with observation sequences, implicitly treating each update as the same amount of physical time. Yet identical observation histories can span different durations and require different actions, exposing physical time as a missing dimension of policy memory. We introduce Temporal Flow Policy (TFP), which learns memory dynamics to retain past events and evolve the memory state over measured time intervals. Observations and prior memory determine the content and time scales of each transition; elapsed time determines how far the state advances. TFP conditions diffusion and flow-matching policies through this memory state and is trained with their native imitation objectives. We evaluate TFP with Diffusion Policy and π_{0.5} through controlled comparisons of memory designs. These experiments show that successful timing depends on both measured intervals and retained history. TFP achieves higher average success than the recurrent and state-space memories we equip with the same intervals and than a variant that feeds the interval to a learned gate. Memory readouts recover the time since an event and motion information after occlusion. Changing the supplied intervals systematically delays or advances actions, linking time inputs to behavior. Real-robot tasks requiring timing or memory, together with LIBERO evaluations, demonstrate benefits in physical and general manipulation. These results suggest viewing robot memory not as stored observation history, but as a state that retains past events and evolves with physical time.
translation:
标题：物理时间：机器人策略记忆动态中被忽视的维度

摘要：现有的机器人策略记忆通常随观测序列演化，隐式地将每次更新视为等同的物理时间量。然而，相同的观测历史可能跨越不同的持续时间并要求不同的动作，这揭示了物理时间是策略记忆中一个缺失的维度。我们提出时序流策略（Temporal Flow Policy, TFP），该策略学习记忆动态以保留过去事件，并在测量的时间间隔内演化记忆状态。观测和先前记忆决定每次状态转移的内容和时间尺度；经过的时间决定状态推进的程度。TFP通过该记忆状态调节扩散与流匹配策略，并使用其原生模仿目标进行训练。我们通过受控的记忆设计对比实验，使用扩散策略和π_{0.5}对TFP进行评估。这些实验表明，成功的时序处理依赖于测量的时间间隔和保留的历史信息。TFP实现了更高的平均成功率，优于我们为其配备相同时间间隔的循环记忆和状态空间记忆，也优于将时间间隔输入学习门控的变体。记忆读出能够恢复事件发生以来的时间以及遮挡后的运动信息。改变所提供的时间间隔会系统性地延迟或提前动作，将时间输入与行为联系起来。需要时序处理或记忆能力的真实机器人任务，连同LIBERO评估，证明了其在物理操作和通用操作中的优势。这些结果表明，应将机器人记忆视为一种保留过去事件并随物理时间演化的状态，而非存储的观测历史。

title: Exploring the Limits of Combinatorial Generalization in Embodied Manipulation
summary: In embodied manipulation, Vision Language Action (VLA) models can execute atomic skills, but long-horizon manipulation requires recombining these skills without demonstrations for every skill combination. The full instruction route treats skill chaining as long-horizon imitation. In a controlled study, full instruction training on limited skill combination sequences reaches 40.0% ordered success on covered combinations but only 7.7% on recombination, suggesting memorization of sequence templates rather than robust skill recombination. We introduce Hierarchical Subtask Execution (HSE), a diagnostic framework that exposes skill recombination through a shared modular interface over the planner, trigger, and policy, decomposing long-horizon failures into separable modes. We introduce RoboCombine, a benchmark for skill recombination without combined skill training trajectories, with metrics for ordered success and transition conversion across subtask boundaries. RoboCombine reveals that atomic competence alone does not ensure ordered execution. Failures concentrate at transitions where downstream subtasks launch from handoff states from preceding subtasks rather than canonical atomic starts. We identify this mismatch as the start state gap. To address it, we introduce Pose Robust Task Initialization (PRTI), a lightweight atomic task post-training strategy that broadens start state coverage beyond canonical starts. Under oracle timed HSE on RoboCombine, PRTI reaches 18.16% ordered success, compared with 4.21% under random perturbation and 9.47% under a robot-reset oracle, without combined skill training trajectories. These results show that combinatorial generalization requires handoff robust atomic skills that convert first stage progress into reliable downstream execution, not merely decomposition into known subtasks. Code: https://github.com/AutoLab-SAI-SJTU/RoboCombine.
translation:
标题：探索具身操作中组合泛化的极限

摘要：在具身操作中，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够执行原子技能，但长时程操作需要在无需为每种技能组合提供演示的情况下重新组合这些技能。完整指令路线将技能串联视为长时程模仿。在一项受控研究中，针对有限技能组合序列的完整指令训练在已覆盖组合上达到40.0%的有序成功率，但在重组组合上仅为7.7%，表明其记忆了序列模板，而非实现稳健的技能重组。我们提出分层子任务执行（HSE），一种诊断框架，通过规划器、触发器和策略之上的共享模块化接口揭示技能重组，并将长时程失败分解为可分离模式。我们提出RoboCombine，一个用于在无组合技能训练轨迹条件下进行技能重组的基准，包含有序成功率和跨子任务边界的转移转化率指标。RoboCombine表明，仅具备原子技能能力并不能确保有序执行。失败集中在过渡环节：下游子任务从前序子任务的交接状态启动，而不是从规范的原子起始状态启动。我们将这一不匹配称为起始状态差距。为解决该问题，我们提出位姿鲁棒任务初始化（PRTI），一种轻量级原子任务后训练策略，可将起始状态覆盖范围扩展到规范起始状态之外。在RoboCombine上采用oracle定时HSE时，PRTI无需组合技能训练轨迹即可达到18.16%的有序成功率，而随机扰动下为4.21%，机器人重置oracle下为9.47%。这些结果表明，组合泛化需要具备交接鲁棒性的原子技能，能够将第一阶段进展转化为可靠的下游执行，而不仅仅是将任务分解为已知子任务。代码：https://github.com/AutoLab-SAI-SJTU/RoboCombine.

title: DecisionRobust: Benchmarking Robustness for JEV Style Decision Models Across Text and Vision
summary: Emerging decision models such as JEV provide typed interfaces that map task instructions and observations directly to choices, judgments, and scores. As these models are increasingly used for automated decision-making, understanding their reliability under adversarial manipulation becomes critical. We introduce DecisionRobust, a benchmark for systematically evaluating the robustness of decision models across textual and visual inputs. Our benchmark covers practical decision-making scenarios and a diverse suite of attacks, including semantics-preserving text perturbations, image perturbations, and prompt injection in both modalities. We curate evaluation sets through external validity checks and cross-model candidate selection. We evaluate 30 model configurations on text tasks and 17 on vision tasks, including 24 and 12 held-out models, respectively, that are excluded from candidate selection. Our experiments reveal several key findings. First, attacks expose vulnerabilities beyond the models used for construction and selection, although optimized image perturbations transfer weakly to many targets even with multiple surrogates. Second, relative model robustness varies across tasks and attack types, and resistance to input perturbations does not necessarily imply resistance to prompt injection. Third, label-consistency checks substantially reduce measured attack success across text and image settings, highlighting the importance of validating apparent failures. The benchmark is available at https://yifan-lan.github.io/DecisionRobust/.
translation:
标题：DecisionRobust：面向文本与视觉的JEV风格决策模型鲁棒性基准测试

摘要：JEV等新兴决策模型提供了类型化接口，可将任务指令和观测结果直接映射为选择、判断和评分。随着这类模型越来越多地用于自动化决策，理解其在对抗性操纵下的可靠性变得至关重要。我们提出了DecisionRobust，这是一个用于系统评估决策模型在文本和视觉输入下鲁棒性的基准测试。我们的基准涵盖了实际决策场景和多样化的攻击套件，包括保持语义的文本扰动、图像扰动以及两种模态中的提示注入。我们通过外部效度检验和跨模型候选选择来构建评估集。我们在文本任务上评估了30种模型配置，在视觉任务上评估了17种，其中分别包括24个和12个未参与候选选择的留出模型。我们的实验揭示了若干关键发现。第一，攻击所暴露的脆弱性超出了用于构建和选择的模型范围，尽管优化的图像扰动即使使用多个替代模型也只能弱迁移到许多目标模型。第二，相对模型鲁棒性因任务和攻击类型而异，对输入扰动的抵抗力并不必然意味着对提示注入的抵抗力。第三，标签一致性检查显著降低了文本和图像设置中测得的攻击成功率，凸显了验证表面失败的重要性。该基准可在 https://yifan-lan.github.io/DecisionRobust/ 获取。

title: Continuum Attention
summary: We introduce Continuum Attention (CA), a causal Transformer attention operator that replaces discrete key and value lookup with integration over a continuous, piecewise linear memory curve. Each query induces an exponential relevance density along the curve. Integrating the density and interpolated values yields exact normalized attention from closed form exponential moments, including half token boundary contributions. The gradients follow analytically from moments of order at most two, enabling parallel GPU implementations while retaining quadratic sequence complexity and the standard Transformer decoder. Compared with ordinary softmax and focal attention, CA reduces mean validation negative log likelihood by 0.0200 and 0.0480 nats per byte, respectively, winning all paired comparisons. An additional disjoint validation slice yields a 0.0457 nats per byte advantage over the strongest selected softmax baseline, with a paired 95% confidence interval. These findings motivate continuous integration as a promising attention alternative while leaving larger scale generalization open.
translation:
标题：连续统注意力

摘要：我们提出连续统注意力（Continuum Attention, CA），一种因果 Transformer 注意力算子，它用对连续分段线性记忆曲线的积分取代离散的键和值查找。每个查询沿该曲线诱导出一个指数相关性密度。对密度与插值后的值进行积分，可由闭式指数矩得到精确的归一化注意力，包括半 token 边界贡献。梯度可由至多二阶矩解析获得，从而支持并行 GPU 实现，同时保持二次序列复杂度和标准 Transformer 解码器。与普通 softmax 注意力和 focal 注意力相比，CA 将平均验证负对数似然分别降低 0.0200 和 0.0480 nats/byte，在所有配对比较中均胜出。在一个额外的、不相交的验证切片上，相较最强的选定 softmax 基线，CA 获得 0.0457 nats/byte 的优势，并给出配对 95% 置信区间。这些发现表明，连续积分是一种有前景的注意力替代方案，而更大规模的泛化仍有待探索。

title: VASPO: Self-Distillation with Privileged Value Estimation
summary: On-policy self-distillation provides dense supervision for reasoning models via a privileged self-teacher. However, this supervision reflects local token preferences rather than the expected return of an unguided student continuation. Recent methods combine this signal with GRPO. They use GRPO for update directions and the teacher for signal scaling. However, we demonstrate a more effective integration within PPO. Specifically, we identify complementary positional dynamics: privileged information enhances a critic's value-prediction accuracy toward the response's end, whereas self-teacher guidance is strong initially, drops mid-generation, and rebounds finally. These insights motivate Value-Augmented Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (VASPO), wherein a self-teacher and critic evaluate identical privileged information at student-generated prefixes. The critic computes token-level PPO advantages from predicted continuation returns, while the self-teacher modulates selected positive advantages via bounded probability ratios. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, VASPO improves mean accuracy over PPO by 2.59 and 1.81 percentage points on Qwen3-4B and OLMo3-7B variants, respectively, and achieves the highest mean accuracy among evaluated methods on Knights and Knaves. Our code is available at https://github.com/cii030/VASPO.
translation:
标题：VASPO：基于特权价值估计的自蒸馏

摘要：同策略自蒸馏通过一个具有特权信息的自教师为推理模型提供密集监督。然而，这种监督反映的是局部词元偏好，而非无引导学生续写的期望回报。近期方法将该信号与 GRPO 结合：以 GRPO 确定更新方向，并以教师进行信号缩放。然而，我们证明在 PPO 框架内进行整合更为有效。具体而言，我们发现了一种互补的位置动态：特权信息会增强 critic 在响应接近末尾时的价值预测准确性，而自教师指导在初始阶段较强，在生成中期下降，并在最后回升。这些发现促成了价值增强自蒸馏策略优化（VASPO）：其中，自教师与 critic 在学生生成的前缀上评估相同的特权信息。critic 根据预测的续写回报计算词元级 PPO 优势，而自教师通过有界概率比调节选定的正优势。在六个数学推理基准上，VASPO 在 Qwen3-4B 和 OLMo3-7B 变体上分别较 PPO 将平均准确率提升 2.59 和 1.81 个百分点，并在 Knights and Knaves 上取得所评估方法中最高的平均准确率。我们的代码见 https://github.com/cii030/VASPO。

title: To Align or Not To Align: Check Your COMPASS Before You Train
summary: Combining pretrained models is a common strategy for building AI systems, whether by aligning a vision encoder with a language model or merging fine-tuned checkpoints. However, finding compatible pairs typically requires costly empirical search, as compatibility is known only after alignment or merging. We propose COMPASS (COMPatibility ASsessment Score), a theoretically motivated diagnostic that estimates whether a model pair will be compatible prior to alignment or merging. Building on the observation that representational convergence is most robust at the level of local neighborhoods, COMPASS decomposes model compatibility into two cheap-to-compute axes: a pair-specific ease, defined as the k-NN overlap between the two encoders, and a paradigm-level ceiling, capturing the maximum overlap their training paradigms allow. Together, these two axes provide a ranking of candidate model pairs and prescribe how to act on each pair: (i) prioritize pairs that already agree and whose paradigms are compatible, (ii) invest additional compute on pairs with compatible paradigms but low initial agreement, (iii) switch the pretraining paradigm when it cannot support sufficient agreement, or (iv) deprioritize pairs that score poorly on both axes. We apply COMPASS to 72 cross-modal alignment experiments and 392 task-arithmetic model merges and show that compatibility estimates by COMPASS strongly correlate with downstream success, achieving average Pearson correlation of 0.91 on cross-modal alignment tasks and 0.70 on model merging.
translation:
标题：对齐，还是不对齐：训练之前请检查你的 COMPASS

摘要：组合预训练模型是构建人工智能系统的常见策略，无论是将视觉编码器与语言模型对齐，还是合并微调检查点。然而，寻找兼容的模型对通常需要代价高昂的实证搜索，因为只有在完成对齐或合并之后才能得知其兼容性。我们提出 COMPASS（COMPatibility ASsessment Score，兼容性评估分数），一种具有理论依据的诊断指标，可在对齐或合并之前估计一对模型是否兼容。基于表征收敛在局部邻域层面最为稳健这一观察，COMPASS 将模型兼容性分解为两个计算成本低廉的轴：模型对特定的易对齐性，定义为两个编码器之间的 k-NN 重叠；以及范式级上限，刻画其训练范式所允许的最大重叠。这两个轴共同给出候选模型对的排序，并指明对每一对模型应采取的行动：(i) 优先考虑已经一致且其范式兼容的模型对；(ii) 对范式兼容但初始一致性较低的模型对投入额外算力；(iii) 当预训练范式无法支持足够的一致性时，切换该预训练范式；或 (iv) 降低在两个轴上得分均较差的模型对的优先级。我们将 COMPASS 应用于 72 个跨模态对齐实验和 392 个任务算术模型合并，结果表明 COMPASS 的兼容性估计与下游成功表现高度相关，在跨模态对齐任务上平均皮尔逊相关系数为 0.91，在模型合并上为 0.70。

title: Rethinking Projector Training in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Multimodal LLMs are typically trained by first aligning a vision encoder with a language model via projector training on large image-caption datasets, followed by joint training of the full multimodal model. Despite its widespread use, the role of the projector training stage remains poorly understood. We find that (i) using only 10 to 20% of the data for training the projector already recovers most downstream performance gains, and (ii) projectors trained on different datasets can be linearly interpolated while largely preserving performance. These results suggest that projector training mainly performs a coarse alignment, which many different projectors achieve equally well. Motivated by these findings, we propose PORTAL, a training-free projector initialization that requires neither paired image-caption data nor gradient-based optimization, but only per-modality summary statistics. PORTAL computes an optimal-transport-based map between Gaussian approximations of the vision and language feature distributions on a shared principal subspace, so that the projector training stage can be skipped entirely. Without any paired data, PORTAL matches the standard pipeline trained on 558k image-caption pairs across six LLM backbones, two vision encoders, and 16 benchmarks. It outperforms that pipeline in 3 of 7 (vision encoder, LLM) settings and reaches an average 98% of its score across the other four.
translation:
标题：重新思考多模态大语言模型中的投影器训练

摘要：多模态大语言模型通常的训练方式是：首先在大规模图像-文本对数据集上通过投影器训练将视觉编码器与语言模型对齐，随后对完整的多模态模型进行联合训练。尽管这一流程被广泛采用，投影器训练阶段的作用仍然缺乏深入理解。我们发现：(i) 仅使用10%至20%的数据训练投影器即可恢复大部分下游性能增益；(ii) 在不同数据集上训练的投影器可以进行线性插值，同时基本保持性能不变。这些结果表明，投影器训练主要执行的是粗对齐，而许多不同的投影器都能同样好地实现这一目标。受这些发现的启发，我们提出了PORTAL，一种无需训练的投影器初始化方法，既不需要配对的图像-文本数据，也不需要基于梯度的优化，仅需各模态的汇总统计量。PORTAL在共享主子空间上计算视觉与语言特征分布的高斯近似之间的最优传输映射，从而可以完全跳过投影器训练阶段。在没有任何配对数据的情况下，PORTAL在六个LLM骨干网络、两个视觉编码器和16个基准测试上，达到了使用55.8万图像-文本对训练的标准流程的同等水平。在7种（视觉编码器、LLM）组合设置中，PORTAL在3种设置下超越了该流程，其余4种设置下平均达到其98%的得分。

title: Rethinking LLM-Guided Visual Question Answering: Does Deeper Knowledge Integration Really Help?
summary: Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering (VQA) requires reasoning that extends beyond visible image content, demanding external commonsense and factual knowledge. While recent work leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) as knowledge sources, the question of how deeply such guidance should be integrated into a vision language architecture remains underexplored. In this work, we generate structured reasoning guidance, visual focus concepts, distractor elements and external knowledge using Llama~3.3~70B and systematically compare two integration strategies within a unified frozen ViT + FLAN-T5 framework on the OK-VQA benchmark: decision level late fusion and attention-matrix injection. Contrary to the prevailing assumption that deeper integration is superior, we find that shallow late fusion achieves the strongest results (39.4% exact match, +10.0 over the no guidance baseline), outperforming deep attention modification (31.8%) under data scarce fine-tuning. We further contribute an LLM based augmentation pipeline that expands training data more than tenfold via question paraphrasing. Our findings indicate that integration depth must be matched to the data regime.
translation:
标题：重新思考LLM引导的视觉问答：更深层的知识整合真的有益吗？
摘要：基于知识的视觉问答（VQA）需要进行超越可见图像内容的推理，并依赖外部常识与事实知识。尽管近期研究利用大语言模型（LLM）作为知识来源，但此类引导应以多深程度整合到视觉语言架构中，这一问题仍未得到充分探索。在本工作中，我们使用 Llama 3.3 70B 生成结构化推理引导、视觉焦点概念、干扰元素和外部知识，并在统一的冻结 ViT + FLAN-T5 框架内，于 OK-VQA 基准上系统比较两种整合策略：决策级晚期融合与注意力矩阵注入。与“更深层整合更优”的普遍假设相反，我们发现浅层晚期融合取得了最佳结果（精确匹配率为 39.4%，较无引导基线提升 10.0 个百分点），在数据稀缺的微调条件下优于深度注意力修改（31.8%）。我们进一步提出一个基于 LLM 的增强流水线，通过问题复述将训练数据扩展十倍以上。我们的发现表明，整合深度必须与数据条件相匹配。
